                    "Resuming: {0} windows on record ({1} loaded), {2} to re-poll, {3} to (re)submit; planning continues below {4:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm}.",
                    existing.Count, existing.Count(w => w.Status == WindowStatus.Loaded), inFlight.Count, pending.Count, _cursor));
            }

            _phase = "Running";
            bool announcedBudget = false;

            while (!ct.IsCancellationRequested)
            {
                // a) Windows handed back by downloaders (row count hit the cap
                //    and the service did not say whether it truncated).
                while (_resplit.TryDequeue(out var r))
                    await SplitAsync(r, pending, "download returned ~cap rows; re-querying as two halves", ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
                while (_resubmit.TryDequeue(out var r))
                    await RetryOrSplitAsync(r, pending, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);

                // b) Poll queries in flight.
                foreach (var w in inFlight.ToList())
                {
                    ct.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
                    QueryState st;
                    try { st = await GetQueryStateAsync(w.QueryId, ct).ConfigureAwait(false); }
                    catch (Exception ex) when (!(ex is OperationCanceledException) && !(ex is FatalGraphException))
                    {
                        Log("WARN", "Status check failed for " + w + ": " + ex.GetBaseException().Message);
                        continue;
                    }

                    if (st.NotFound)
                    {
                        inFlight.Remove(w);
                        Log("WARN", w + ": query " + w.QueryId + " no longer exists - resubmitting.");
                        w.QueryId = null; w.Status = WindowStatus.Pending;
                        await _store.UpdateAsync(w, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
                        pending.AddFirst(w);
                        continue;
                    }

                    var status = (st.Status ?? "").ToLowerInvariant();
                    // Microsoft can mark a search failed although it found records, and they still download. Load them
                    // rather than retry a window that will fail the same way; one over the record cap is split as usual.
                    var fromFailed = false;
                    if (status == "failed" && (st.ApproxRecords ?? 0) > 0)
                    {
                        fromFailed = true;
                        Log("WARN", w + ": Microsoft marked the search failed but it found ~" + st.ApproxRecords + " records - " +
                            (st.CapExceeded == true ? "over the record cap, so handled as a capped search." : "loading them."));
                        status = "succeeded";
                    }
                    if (status == "succeeded")
                    {
                        inFlight.Remove(w);
                        w.FromFailedSearch = fromFailed;
                        w.ApproxRecords = st.ApproxRecords;
                        w.CapExceeded = st.CapExceeded;
                        if (st.RecordCap.HasValue && st.RecordCap.Value > 0) w.RecordCap = st.RecordCap.Value;

                        if (st.CapExceeded == true)
                        {
                            long cap = w.RecordCap > 0 ? w.RecordCap : _o.AssumedRecordCap;
                            ObserveDensity(Math.Max(cap, st.ApproxRecords ?? 0), w.Hours);
                            if (w.Hours > _o.MinWindowHours * 2)
                            {
                                await SplitAsync(w, pending, string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,
                                    "service reports the {0:N0}-record cap was exceeded", cap), ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
                                continue;
                            }
                            Log("WARN", w + ": over the record cap even at the minimum window size - loading what the service returned.");
                        }
                        else if (st.ApproxRecords.HasValue)
                        {
                            ObserveDensity(st.ApproxRecords.Value, w.Hours);
                        }

                        w.Status = WindowStatus.Ready;
                        await _store.UpdateAsync(w, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
                        Interlocked.Increment(ref _windowsInDownload);
                        _ready.Writer.TryWrite(w);
                        Log("INFO", string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0}: search complete{1} - queued for download.",
                            w, st.ApproxRecords.HasValue ? string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, ", ~{0:N0} records", st.ApproxRecords.Value) : ""));
                    }
                    else if (status == "failed" || status == "cancelled")
                    {
                        inFlight.Remove(w);
                        var raw = st.Raw ?? "";
                        w.LastError = "audit search " + status + (raw.Length == 0 ? "" : ": " + raw.Substring(0, Math.Min(1500, raw.Length)));
                        Log("WARN", w + ": " + w.LastError);
                        await RetryOrSplitAsync(w, pending, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
                    }
                    else if (w.SubmittedUtc.HasValue && DateTime.UtcNow - w.SubmittedUtc.Value > TimeSpan.FromMinutes(_o.QueryTimeoutMinutes))
                    {
                        inFlight.Remove(w);
                        w.LastError = "audit search still '" + status + "' after " + _o.QueryTimeoutMinutes + " minutes";
                        await RetryOrSplitAsync(w, pending, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
                    }
                }
                Volatile.Write(ref _queriesInFlight, inFlight.Count);

                // c) Submit more, within the in-flight cap and the rolling budget.
                while (inFlight.Count < _o.MaxQueriesInFlight && !ct.IsCancellationRequested)
                {
                    var blocked = new DateTime(Interlocked.Read(ref _submitBlockedUntilTicks), DateTimeKind.Utc);
                    if (DateTime.UtcNow < blocked) break;

                    int used;
                    DateTime oldest;
                    lock (_submitLock) { PruneSubmitTimes(); used = _submitTimes.Count; oldest = used > 0 ? _submitTimes.Peek() : DateTime.UtcNow; }
                    if (used >= _o.MaxSubmissionsPer24h)
                    {
                        var until = oldest.AddHours(24).AddMinutes(1);
                        Interlocked.Exchange(ref _submitBlockedUntilTicks, until.Ticks);
                        if (!announcedBudget)
                        {
                            Log("WARN", string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,
                                "Submission budget reached ({0} in the last 24h). Next submission at {1:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm}Z; downloads continue meanwhile.",
                                used, until));
                            announcedBudget = true;
                        }
                        break;
                    }
                    announcedBudget = false;

                    AuditWindow next = null;
                    if (pending.First != null) { next = pending.First.Value; pending.RemoveFirst(); }
                    else if (_cursor > _o.RangeStartUtc)
                    {
                        next = PlanNext();
                        await _store.InsertAsync(next, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
                        _windows[next.WindowId] = next;
                    }
                    else break;

                    SubmitOutcome outcome;
                    try { outcome = await SubmitAsync(next, ct).ConfigureAwait(false); }
                    catch (FatalGraphException) { pending.AddFirst(next); throw; }
                    if (outcome == SubmitOutcome.Submitted)
                    {
                        inFlight.Add(next);
                    }
                    else if (outcome == SubmitOutcome.Throttled)
                    {
                        pending.AddFirst(next);
                        break;
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        await RetryOrSplitAsync(next, pending, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
                        break;
                    }
                }
                Volatile.Write(ref _queriesInFlight, inFlight.Count);

                // d) Done when nothing is left anywhere upstream of the writers.
                if (pending.Count == 0 && inFlight.Count == 0 && _cursor <= _o.RangeStartUtc &&
                    Volatile.Read(ref _windowsInDownload) == 0 && _resplit.IsEmpty && _resubmit.IsEmpty)
                {
                    break;
                }

                await Task.Delay(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(inFlight.Count > 0 ? _o.StatusPollSeconds : 2), ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
            }

            _phase = "Draining";
            _ready.Writer.TryComplete();
        }

        void PruneSubmitTimes()
        {
            var cutoff = DateTime.UtcNow.AddHours(-24);
            while (_submitTimes.Count > 0 && _submitTimes.Peek() < cutoff) _submitTimes.Dequeue();
        }

        // Called from the planner and from the SQL writers (TryFinishAsync), so the
        // write is volatile and PlanNext reads it once.
        void ObserveDensity(long records, double hours)
        {
            if (hours <= 0) return;
            Volatile.Write(ref _density, records / hours);
        }

        AuditWindow PlanNext()
        {
            // density < 0: nothing observed yet. 0: the last window was empty, which
            // must widen the next one (sparse tenants, days past retention) rather
            // than fall back to the initial size and exhaust the submission budget.
            double density = Volatile.Read(ref _density);
            double hours = density < 0 ? _o.InitialWindowHours
                         : density == 0 ? _o.MaxWindowHours
                         : _o.TargetRecordsPerWindow / density;
            if (density >= 0) hours = Math.Min(hours, _lastPlannedHours * 2);   // grow cautiously
            hours = Math.Max(_o.MinWindowHours, Math.Min(_o.MaxWindowHours, hours));
            if (hours >= 1) hours = Math.Floor(hours);                           // whole hours when possible

            var start = _cursor.AddMinutes(-Math.Round(hours * 60));
            if (start < _o.RangeStartUtc) start = _o.RangeStartUtc;

            var w = new AuditWindow { StartUtc = start, EndUtc = _cursor, Status = WindowStatus.Pending };
            _cursor = start;
            _lastPlannedHours = hours;
            return w;
        }

        async Task SplitAsync(AuditWindow w, LinkedList<AuditWindow> pending, string reason, CancellationToken ct)
        {
            var span = w.EndUtc - w.StartUtc;
            var mid = w.StartUtc.AddMinutes(Math.Floor(span.TotalMinutes / 2));
            if (mid <= w.StartUtc || mid >= w.EndUtc)
            {
                Log("ERROR", w + ": cannot split further (" + reason + ").");
                w.Status = WindowStatus.Failed;
                w.LastError = reason;
                await _store.UpdateAsync(w, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
                return;
            }

            w.Status = WindowStatus.Split;
            w.LastError = reason;
            var older = new AuditWindow { ParentWindowId = w.WindowId, StartUtc = w.StartUtc, EndUtc = mid };
            var newer = new AuditWindow { ParentWindowId = w.WindowId, StartUtc = mid, EndUtc = w.EndUtc };
            await _store.SplitAsync(w, older, newer, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
            _windows[older.WindowId] = older;
            _windows[newer.WindowId] = newer;
            pending.AddFirst(older);
            pending.AddFirst(newer);
            Log("INFO", string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0}: split ({1}) into {2} and {3}.", w, reason, newer, older));
        }

        // The parts of a Split window's range that none of its halves covers, as new windows: both halves, cut where
        // SplitAsync cuts, when neither was written.
        static List<AuditWindow> MissingHalves(AuditWindow parent, List<AuditWindow> all)
        {
            var missing = new List<AuditWindow>();
            var halves = all.Where(x => x.ParentWindowId == parent.WindowId).OrderBy(x => x.StartUtc).ToList();
            if (halves.Count == 0)
            {
                var mid = parent.StartUtc.AddMinutes(Math.Floor((parent.EndUtc - parent.StartUtc).TotalMinutes / 2));
                if (mid > parent.StartUtc && mid < parent.EndUtc)
                {
                    missing.Add(new AuditWindow { ParentWindowId = parent.WindowId, StartUtc = parent.StartUtc, EndUtc = mid });
                    missing.Add(new AuditWindow { ParentWindowId = parent.WindowId, StartUtc = mid, EndUtc = parent.EndUtc });
                }
                else missing.Add(new AuditWindow { ParentWindowId = parent.WindowId, StartUtc = parent.StartUtc, EndUtc = parent.EndUtc });
                return missing;
            }
            var at = parent.StartUtc;
            foreach (var h in halves)
            {
                if (h.StartUtc > at) missing.Add(new AuditWindow { ParentWindowId = parent.WindowId, StartUtc = at, EndUtc = h.StartUtc });
                if (h.EndUtc > at) at = h.EndUtc;
            }
            if (at < parent.EndUtc) missing.Add(new AuditWindow { ParentWindowId = parent.WindowId, StartUtc = at, EndUtc = parent.EndUtc });
            return missing;
        }

        async Task RetryOrSplitAsync(AuditWindow w, LinkedList<AuditWindow> pending, CancellationToken ct)
        {
            w.QueryId = null;
            if (w.Submissions < 2)
            {
                Log("WARN", w + ": " + (w.LastError ?? "submission failed") + " - retrying.");
                w.Status = WindowStatus.Pending;
                await _store.UpdateAsync(w, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
                pending.AddLast(w);
            }
            else if (w.Hours > _o.MinWindowHours * 2)
            {
                await SplitAsync(w, pending, (w.LastError ?? "repeated failures"), ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
            }
            else if (w.Submissions < _o.MaxWindowAttempts)
            {
                w.Status = WindowStatus.Pending;
                await _store.UpdateAsync(w, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
                pending.AddLast(w);
            }
            else
            {
                w.Status = WindowStatus.Failed;
                await _store.UpdateAsync(w, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
                Log("ERROR", w + ": giving up after " + w.Submissions + " submissions (" + w.LastError + "). Re-run to retry it.");
            }
        }

        enum SubmitOutcome { Submitted, Throttled, Failed }

        async Task<SubmitOutcome> SubmitAsync(AuditWindow w, CancellationToken ct)
        {
            var body = new Dictionary<string, object>
            {
                ["@odata.type"] = "#microsoft.graph.security.auditLogQuery",
                ["displayName"] = string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "CopilotBackfill {0:yyyyMMdd-HHmm}-{1:yyyyMMdd-HHmm}", w.StartUtc, w.EndUtc),
                ["filterStartDateTime"] = w.StartUtc.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z'", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                ["filterEndDateTime"] = w.EndUtc.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z'", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
            };
            // A record-type load asks for whole record types and names no operation.
            if (_o.Operations != null && _o.Operations.Length > 0) body["operationFilters"] = _o.Operations;
            if (_o.RecordTypes != null && _o.RecordTypes.Length > 0) body["recordTypeFilters"] = _o.RecordTypes;
            var json = JsonSerializer.Serialize(body);

            /* A search by record type goes to beta: v1.0's list of record types lacks the newer ones
               (ConnectedAIAppInteraction, CopilotInteraction among them) and may refuse them. Its records are read as any other's. */
            var submitVersion = _o.RecordTypes != null && _o.RecordTypes.Length > 0 ? "/beta" : "/v1.0";
            var resp = await SendControlAsync(HttpMethod.Post, _o.GraphBaseUrl + submitVersion + "/security/auditLog/queries", json, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
            if (resp.Status == 429)
            {
                Interlocked.Increment(ref _submitThrottles);
                var wait = resp.RetryAfter ?? TimeSpan.FromMinutes(5);
                Interlocked.Exchange(ref _submitBlockedUntilTicks, (DateTime.UtcNow + wait).Ticks);
                Log("WARN", string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,
                    "Audit search submission throttled (429). Waiting {0:N0} min before the next submission; downloads continue.", wait.TotalMinutes));
                return SubmitOutcome.Throttled;
            }
            if (resp.Status == 400 || resp.Status == 403)
            {
                // Not transient: a bad filter or a missing permission/role. Retrying or
                // splitting would only burn the tenant's submission budget.
                throw new GraphRequestException(resp.Status, resp.Body,
                    "audit search submission" + (resp.Status == 403
                        ? " (the signed-in account needs AuditLogsQuery.Read.All consented AND an Audit Reader/Manager role in Purview)"
                        : ""));
            }
            if (resp.Status < 200 || resp.Status > 299)
            {
                w.Submissions++;
                w.LastError = "submit failed: HTTP " + resp.Status + " " + resp.Body;
                Log("WARN", w + ": " + w.LastError);
                return SubmitOutcome.Failed;
            }

            using (var doc = JsonDocument.Parse(resp.Body))
            {
                w.QueryId = doc.RootElement.GetProperty("id").GetString();
            }
            w.Submissions++;
            w.Status = WindowStatus.Submitted;
            w.SubmittedUtc = DateTime.UtcNow;
            w.LastError = null;
            await _store.UpdateAsync(w, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
            lock (_submitLock) _submitTimes.Enqueue(w.SubmittedUtc.Value);
            Interlocked.Increment(ref _submissions);
            Log("INFO", string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0}: submitted ({1:N1}h, query {2}).", w, w.Hours, w.QueryId));
            return SubmitOutcome.Submitted;
        }

        sealed class QueryState
        {
            public bool NotFound;
            public string Status;
            public bool? CapExceeded;
            public long? RecordCap;
            public long? ApproxRecords;
            public string Raw;   // Microsoft's whole answer, for the log when a search fails
        }

        async Task<QueryState> GetQueryStateAsync(string queryId, CancellationToken ct)
        {
            if (_useBeta)
            {
                var b = await SendControlAsync(HttpMethod.Get, _o.GraphBaseUrl + "/beta/security/auditLog/queries/" + queryId, null, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
                if (b.Status >= 200 && b.Status < 300) return ParseQueryState(b.Body);
                if (b.Status != 429)
                {
                    _useBeta = false;
                    Log("WARN", "Beta status endpoint unavailable (HTTP " + b.Status + ") - using v1.0. Over-cap windows will be detected by row count instead.");
                }
                else
                {
                    return new QueryState { Status = "running" };   // treat as not-yet-known; poll again later
                }
            }

            var v = await SendControlAsync(HttpMethod.Get, _o.GraphBaseUrl + "/v1.0/security/auditLog/queries/" + queryId, null, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
            if (v.Status == 404) return new QueryState { NotFound = true };
            if (v.Status == 429) return new QueryState { Status = "running" };
            if (v.Status == 403) throw new FatalGraphException(new GraphRequestException(v.Status, v.Body, "status " + queryId));
            if (v.Status < 200 || v.Status > 299) throw new GraphRequestException(v.Status, v.Body, "status " + queryId);
            return ParseQueryState(v.Body);
        }

        static QueryState ParseQueryState(string json)
        {
            using (var doc = JsonDocument.Parse(json))
            {
                var r = doc.RootElement;
                var s = new QueryState();
                if (r.TryGetProperty("status", out var st) && st.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.String) s.Status = st.GetString();
                if (r.TryGetProperty("isRecordCountLimitExceeded", out var ex) &&
                    (ex.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.True || ex.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.False)) s.CapExceeded = ex.GetBoolean();
                if (r.TryGetProperty("recordCountLimit", out var cap) && cap.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Number) s.RecordCap = cap.GetInt64();
                if (r.TryGetProperty("approximateReturnedRecordCount", out var ap) && ap.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Number) s.ApproxRecords = ap.GetInt64();
                s.Raw = json;
                return s;
            }
        }

        struct ControlResponse
        {
            public int Status;
            public string Body;
            public TimeSpan? RetryAfter;
        }

        /// <summary>Low-volume control-plane calls (submit / status). Not subject to the page limiter.</summary>
        async Task<ControlResponse> SendControlAsync(HttpMethod method, string url, string jsonBody, CancellationToken ct)
        {
            for (int attempt = 1; ; attempt++)
            {
                long tv = Interlocked.Read(ref _tokenVersion);
                try
                {
                    using (var req = new HttpRequestMessage(method, url))
                    {
                        req.Headers.Authorization = new AuthenticationHeaderValue("Bearer", _token);
                        req.Headers.Accept.Add(new MediaTypeWithQualityHeaderValue("application/json"));
                        req.Headers.Add("client-request-id", Guid.NewGuid().ToString());
                        if (jsonBody != null) req.Content = new StringContent(jsonBody, Encoding.UTF8, "application/json");

                        using (var resp = await _http.SendAsync(req, ct).ConfigureAwait(false))
                        {
                            int code = (int)resp.StatusCode;
                            if (code == 401)
                            {
                                await WaitForFreshTokenAsync(tv, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
                                continue;
                            }
                            if ((code >= 500 || code == 408) && attempt < 5)
                            {
                                await Task.Delay(Backoff(attempt), ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
                                continue;
                            }
                            return new ControlResponse
                            {
                                Status = code,
                                Body = await resp.Content.ReadAsStringAsync(ct).ConfigureAwait(false),
                                RetryAfter = RetryAfterOf(resp)
                            };
                        }
                    }
                }
                catch (HttpRequestException) when (attempt < 5)
                {
                    await Task.Delay(Backoff(attempt), ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
                }
                catch (TaskCanceledException) when (!ct.IsCancellationRequested && attempt < 5)
                {
                    await Task.Delay(Backoff(attempt), ct).ConfigureAwait(false);   // HttpClient timeout
                }
                catch (System.IO.IOException) when (attempt < 5)
                {
                    await Task.Delay(Backoff(attempt), ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
                }
            }
        }

        // ---------------- downloads -------------------------------------------

        async Task DownloadLoopAsync(CancellationToken ct)
        {
            await foreach (var w in _ready.Reader.ReadAllAsync(ct).ConfigureAwait(false))
            {
                Interlocked.Increment(ref _downloadingNow);
                try
                {
                    await DownloadWindowAsync(w, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
                }
                catch (FatalGraphException)
                {
                    throw;
                }
                catch (GraphRequestException gx) when ((gx.StatusCode == 400 || gx.StatusCode == 403) && w.FromFailedSearch)
                {
                    // A search Microsoft marked failed reported records but will not serve them: search the window
                    // again, as a failed search always was, rather than stop the whole load. Rows of this attempt are
                    // superseded by the next attempt's, as for any re-download.
                    w.FromFailedSearch = false;
                    w.LastError = "audit search failed and its records could not be downloaded: " + gx.Message;
                    Log("WARN", w + ": " + w.LastError + " - searching it again.");
                    _resubmit.Enqueue(w);                         // enqueue before decrement (planner termination check)
                    Interlocked.Decrement(ref _windowsInDownload);
                }
                catch (GraphRequestException gx) when (gx.StatusCode == 400 || gx.StatusCode == 403)
                {
                    throw new FatalGraphException(gx);
                }
                catch (Exception ex) when (!(ex is OperationCanceledException && ct.IsCancellationRequested))
                {
                    w.LastError = "download: " + ex.GetBaseException().Message;
                    if (w.Attempts < _o.MaxWindowAttempts)
                    {
                        Log("WARN", w + ": " + w.LastError + " - will re-download (attempt " + (w.Attempts + 1) + ").");
                        w.Status = WindowStatus.Ready;
                        await _store.UpdateAsync(w, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
                        await Task.Delay(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(30), ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
                        _ready.Writer.TryWrite(w);      // still counted in _windowsInDownload
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        w.Status = WindowStatus.Failed;
                        await _store.UpdateAsync(w, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
                        Log("ERROR", w + ": " + w.LastError + " - giving up after " + w.Attempts + " attempts. Re-run to retry it.");
                        Interlocked.Decrement(ref _windowsInDownload);
                    }
                }
                finally
                {
                    Interlocked.Decrement(ref _downloadingNow);
                }
            }
        }

        async Task DownloadWindowAsync(AuditWindow w, CancellationToken ct)
        {
            w.Attempts++;
            w.Status = WindowStatus.Downloading;
            await _store.UpdateAsync(w, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);

            var st = new AttemptState(w, w.Attempts);
            string baseUrl = _o.GraphBaseUrl + "/v1.0/security/auditLog/queries/" + w.QueryId + "/records";
            string url = _useTop ? baseUrl + "?$top=" + _o.PageSize.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) : baseUrl;
            bool firstPage = true;
            var batch = NewBatch(st);

            while (url != null)
            {
                JsonDocument doc;
                try
                {
                    doc = await GetPageAsync(url, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
                }
                catch (GraphRequestException gx) when (firstPage && gx.StatusCode == 400 && _useTop)
                {
                    _useTop = false;
                    Log("WARN", "Service rejected $top=" + _o.PageSize + " - falling back to the default page size.");
                    url = baseUrl;
                    continue;
                }
                firstPage = false;

                using (doc)
                {
                    var root = doc.RootElement;
                    int n = 0;
                    if (root.TryGetProperty("value", out var values) && values.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Array)
                    {
                        foreach (var rec in values.EnumerateArray())
                        {
                            var row = MapRow(rec, st);
                            if (row == null) continue;
                            batch.Rows.Add(row);
                            n++;
                            if (batch.Rows.Count >= _o.BatchRows)
                            {
                                await EnqueueAsync(batch, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
                                batch = NewBatch(st);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    st.Rows += n;
                    Interlocked.Add(ref _rowsDownloaded, n);
                    Interlocked.Increment(ref _pages);

                    url = root.TryGetProperty("@odata.nextLink", out var next) && next.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.String
                        ? next.GetString() : null;
                }
            }

            if (batch.Rows.Count > 0) await EnqueueAsync(batch, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);

            // Fallback truncation check when the service did not report the cap flag.
            long cap = w.RecordCap > 0 ? w.RecordCap : _o.AssumedRecordCap;
            if (w.CapExceeded == null && st.Rows >= (long)(cap * 0.98) && w.Hours > _o.MinWindowHours * 2)
            {
                Log("WARN", string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,
                    "{0}: {1:N0} rows is at the ~{2:N0} record cap and the service did not report truncation - discarding this attempt and splitting.",
                    w, st.Rows, cap));
                _resplit.Enqueue(w);                          // enqueue before decrement (planner termination check)
                Interlocked.Decrement(ref _windowsInDownload);
                return;
            }

            Interlocked.Exchange(ref st.DownloadDone, 1);
            if (Interlocked.CompareExchange(ref st.Outstanding, 0, 0) == 0)
                await TryFinishAsync(st, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
            Interlocked.Decrement(ref _windowsInDownload);
        }

        static RowBatch NewBatch(AttemptState st) => new RowBatch { State = st, Rows = new List<object[]>() };

        async Task EnqueueAsync(RowBatch batch, CancellationToken ct)
        {
            Interlocked.Increment(ref batch.State.Outstanding);
            try
            {
                await _batches.Writer.WriteAsync(batch, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);   // back-pressure when SQL lags
            }
            catch
            {
                Interlocked.Decrement(ref batch.State.Outstanding);
                throw;
            }
        }

        async Task<JsonDocument> GetPageAsync(string url, CancellationToken ct)
        {
            int transient = 0;
            while (true)
            {
                await _limiter.WaitAsync(ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
                long tv = Interlocked.Read(ref _tokenVersion);
                HttpResponseMessage resp = null;
                // Each page has a time limit of its own, body included. HttpClient's timeout ends once the
                // headers arrive (ResponseHeadersRead), so a connection that went silent mid-body - a proxy or firewall
                // dropping it without a reset - was awaited forever, and the whole run with it, until Task Scheduler
                // killed it 20 hours later.
                var page = CancellationTokenSource.CreateLinkedTokenSource(ct);
                page.CancelAfter(TimeSpan.FromMinutes(_o.PageTimeoutMinutes));
                try
                {
                    using (var req = new HttpRequestMessage(HttpMethod.Get, url))
                    {
                        req.Headers.Authorization = new AuthenticationHeaderValue("Bearer", _token);
                        req.Headers.Accept.Add(new MediaTypeWithQualityHeaderValue("application/json"));
                        req.Headers.Add("client-request-id", Guid.NewGuid().ToString());
                        resp = await _http.SendAsync(req, HttpCompletionOption.ResponseHeadersRead, page.Token).ConfigureAwait(false);
                    }

                    int code = (int)resp.StatusCode;
                    if (resp.IsSuccessStatusCode)
                    {
                        using (var stream = await resp.Content.ReadAsStreamAsync(page.Token).ConfigureAwait(false))
                        {
                            var doc = await JsonDocument.ParseAsync(stream, default, page.Token).ConfigureAwait(false);
                            _limiter.OnSuccess(_o.IncreaseAfterCleanPages);
                            return doc;
                        }
                    }
                    if (code == 429)
                    {
                        Interlocked.Increment(ref _pageThrottles);
                        var pause = _limiter.OnThrottled(RetryAfterOf(resp));
                        Log("WARN", string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,
                            "Page request throttled (429). All streams paused {0:N0}s; concurrency cut to {1}.",
                            pause.TotalSeconds, _limiter.Limit));
                        continue;
                    }
                    if (code == 401)
                    {
                        await WaitForFreshTokenAsync(tv, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
                        continue;
                    }
                    if ((code >= 500 || code == 408) && ++transient <= 8)
                    {
                        await Task.Delay(Backoff(transient), ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
                        continue;
                    }
                    var body = await resp.Content.ReadAsStringAsync(page.Token).ConfigureAwait(false);
                    throw new GraphRequestException(code, body, url);
                }
                catch (HttpRequestException ex) when (++transient <= 8)
                {
                    Log("WARN", "Network error paging records (" + ex.Message + ") - retrying.");
                    await Task.Delay(Backoff(transient), ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
                }
                catch (OperationCanceledException) when (!ct.IsCancellationRequested && ++transient <= 8)
                {
                    // The page's own limit, or HttpClient's: not a stop.
                    Log("WARN", "Page request timed out - retrying.");
                    await Task.Delay(Backoff(transient), ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
                }
                catch (JsonException) when (++transient <= 8)
                {
                    Log("WARN", "Truncated/invalid JSON page - retrying.");
                    await Task.Delay(Backoff(transient), ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
                }
                catch (System.IO.IOException ex) when (++transient <= 8)
                {
                    // .NET 8 surfaces a connection dropped mid-body as HttpIOException (an IOException).
                    Log("WARN", "Connection dropped while reading a page (" + ex.Message + ") - retrying.");
                    await Task.Delay(Backoff(transient), ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
                }
                finally
                {
                    resp?.Dispose();
                    page.Dispose();
                    _limiter.Release();
                }
            }
        }

        object[] MapRow(JsonElement rec, AttemptState st)
        {
            var row = new object[RowSchema.Columns.Length];
            row[0] = st.Window.WindowId;
            row[1] = st.Attempt;

            string id = Str(rec, "id");
            JsonElement ad = default;
            bool hasAudit = rec.TryGetProperty("auditData", out ad) &&
                            ad.ValueKind != JsonValueKind.Null && ad.ValueKind != JsonValueKind.Undefined;
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(id) && hasAudit && ad.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Object) id = Str(ad, "Id");
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(id)) { Interlocked.Increment(ref _skipped); return null; }
            row[2] = Fit(id, 2);

            string created = Str(rec, "createdDateTime");
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(created) && hasAudit && ad.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Object) created = Str(ad, "CreationTime");
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(created) ||
                !DateTime.TryParse(created, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,
                                   DateTimeStyles.AdjustToUniversal | DateTimeStyles.AssumeUniversal, out var createdUtc))
            {
                Interlocked.Increment(ref _skipped);
                return null;
            }
            row[3] = createdUtc;
            TrackRange(createdUtc.Ticks);

            foreach (var (col, prop) in RowSchema.Scalars) row[col] = Fit(Str(rec, prop), col);

            if (rec.TryGetProperty("administrativeUnits", out var au) && au.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Array)
            {
                var sb = new StringBuilder();
                foreach (var a in au.EnumerateArray())
                {
                    if (sb.Length > 0) sb.Append(';');
                    sb.Append(a.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.String ? a.GetString() : a.GetRawText());
                }
                row[13] = sb.Length > 0 ? Fit(sb.ToString(), 13) : null;
            }

            row[14] = hasAudit ? Gzip(ad.GetRawText()) : null;
            return row;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// gzip of the UTF-16LE JSON - exactly what SQL Server's COMPRESS() produces
        /// for NVARCHAR, so CAST(DECOMPRESS(AuditDataGz) AS NVARCHAR(MAX)) reads it
        /// back. Measured on Microsoft's documented CopilotInteraction samples:
        /// 2.4x for a record with one accessed file, 7.2x with eight - both land
        /// around 1.1-1.3 KB per record, versus 2.5-9 KB uncompressed.
        /// </summary>
        byte[] Gzip(string json)
        {
            var raw = Encoding.Unicode.GetBytes(json);
            using (var ms = new MemoryStream(raw.Length / 4 + 64))
            {
                using (var gz = new GZipStream(ms, CompressionLevel.Fastest, leaveOpen: true))
                    gz.Write(raw, 0, raw.Length);
                var packed = ms.ToArray();
                Interlocked.Add(ref _auditBytesRaw, raw.Length);
                Interlocked.Add(ref _auditBytesPacked, packed.Length);
                return packed;
            }
        }

        static string Str(JsonElement e, string prop)
        {
            if (e.ValueKind != JsonValueKind.Object || !e.TryGetProperty(prop, out var v)) return null;
            switch (v.ValueKind)
            {
                case JsonValueKind.String: return v.GetString();
                case JsonValueKind.Null:
                case JsonValueKind.Undefined: return null;
                default: return v.GetRawText();
            }
        }

        string Fit(string value, int col)
        {
            int max = RowSchema.MaxLength[col];
            if (value == null || max <= 0 || value.Length <= max) return value;
            Interlocked.Increment(ref _truncated);
            return value.Substring(0, max);
        }

        void TrackRange(long ticks)
        {
            long cur;
            while (ticks < (cur = Interlocked.Read(ref _oldestTicks)) &&
                   Interlocked.CompareExchange(ref _oldestTicks, ticks, cur) != cur) { }
            while (ticks > (cur = Interlocked.Read(ref _newestTicks)) &&
                   Interlocked.CompareExchange(ref _newestTicks, ticks, cur) != cur) { }
        }

        // ---------------- SQL writers -----------------------------------------

        async Task WriterLoopAsync(CancellationToken ct)
        {
            await foreach (var batch in _batches.Reader.ReadAllAsync(ct).ConfigureAwait(false))
            {
                for (int attempt = 1; ; attempt++)
                {
                    try
                    {
                        await _sink.WriteAsync(batch, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
                        break;
                    }
                    catch (TransientException tx) when (attempt < 6 && !ct.IsCancellationRequested)
                    {
                        Log("WARN", "SQL write failed transiently (" + tx.Message + ") - retry " + attempt + ".");
                        await Task.Delay(Backoff(attempt), ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
                    }
                }

                Interlocked.Add(ref _rowsWritten, batch.Rows.Count);
                var st = batch.State;
                if (Interlocked.Decrement(ref st.Outstanding) == 0 &&
                    Interlocked.CompareExchange(ref st.DownloadDone, 0, 0) == 1)
                {
                    await TryFinishAsync(st, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
                }
            }
        }

        async Task TryFinishAsync(AttemptState st, CancellationToken ct)
        {
            if (Interlocked.Exchange(ref st.Finished, 1) != 0) return;
            var w = st.Window;
            w.Status = WindowStatus.Loaded;
            w.RowsLoaded = st.Rows;
            w.CompletedUtc = DateTime.UtcNow;
            w.LastError = null;
            // A window loaded from a search Microsoft marked failed keeps a note in its state row, so a gap it may
            // leave can be found later; fewer rows than the search reported is said in the log as well.
            if (w.FromFailedSearch)
            {
                w.LastError = string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,
                    "loaded from a search Microsoft marked failed: ~{0:N0} records reported, {1:N0} loaded", w.ApproxRecords ?? 0, st.Rows);
                if (w.ApproxRecords.HasValue && st.Rows < w.ApproxRecords.Value * 0.9)
                    Log("WARN", w + ": " + w.LastError + ". Fewer than reported: those hours may be incomplete. The next -Incremental run searches them again if they are inside its -LookbackHours (RUNBOOK section 8).");
            }
            // The rows actually loaded are the only density signal when the status
            // call reports no approximate count - which a live tenant did for every
            // search, Copilot and Entra alike. Without this, a fresh run plans every
            // window at InitialWindowHours and only a restart (which reads the last
            // loaded window) lets them grow.
            if (!w.ApproxRecords.HasValue) ObserveDensity(st.Rows, w.Hours);
            await _store.UpdateAsync(w, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
            Log("INFO", string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0}: loaded {1:N0} rows.", w, st.Rows));
        }

        // ---------------- helpers ---------------------------------------------

        async Task WaitForFreshTokenAsync(long seenVersion, CancellationToken ct)
        {
            if (Interlocked.Exchange(ref _tokenRefreshRequested, 1) == 0)
                Log("WARN", "Graph returned 401 - waiting for a fresh access token.");
            var deadline = DateTime.UtcNow.AddMinutes(_o.TokenWaitMinutes);
            while (Interlocked.Read(ref _tokenVersion) == seenVersion)
            {
                if (DateTime.UtcNow > deadline)
                {
                    // Nobody completed the sign-in. Stop the whole pipeline rather than
                    // burning window retries; everything done so far is saved.
                    throw new FatalGraphException(new InvalidOperationException(string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,
                        "Graph rejected the access token and no new sign-in completed within {0:N0} minutes. " +
                        "Progress is saved - run the same command again to resume.", _o.TokenWaitMinutes)));
                }
                await Task.Delay(250, ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
            }
        }

        static TimeSpan Backoff(int attempt) =>
            TimeSpan.FromSeconds(Math.Min(120, Math.Pow(2, attempt)) + Random.Shared.NextDouble() * 2);

        static TimeSpan? RetryAfterOf(HttpResponseMessage resp)
        {
            var ra = resp.Headers.RetryAfter;
            if (ra == null) return null;
            if (ra.Delta.HasValue) return ra.Delta.Value;
            if (ra.Date.HasValue)
            {
                var d = ra.Date.Value - DateTimeOffset.UtcNow;
                return d > TimeSpan.Zero ? d : TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1);
            }
            return null;
        }

        static DateTime? JwtExpiry(string jwt)
        {
            try
            {
                var parts = jwt.Split('.');
                if (parts.Length < 2) return null;
                var p = parts[1].Replace('-', '+').Replace('_', '/');
                switch (p.Length % 4) { case 2: p += "=="; break; case 3: p += "="; break; }
                using (var doc = JsonDocument.Parse(Convert.FromBase64String(p)))
                {
                    if (doc.RootElement.TryGetProperty("exp", out var e) && e.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Number)
                        return DateTimeOffset.FromUnixTimeSeconds(e.GetInt64()).UtcDateTime;
                }
            }
            catch { }
            return null;
        }
    }
}

================================================================================
FILE: Invoke-CopilotAuditBackfill.ps1
================================================================================
<#
.SYNOPSIS
    Backfills Microsoft 365 Copilot audit records (CopilotInteraction) from
    Microsoft Purview straight into SQL Server - fast, resumable, and within
    Microsoft's published Audit Search API limits.

.DESCRIPTION
    Pipeline: Purview audit searches -> parallel page downloads -> parallel
    SqlBulkCopy. Nothing is written to CSV.

      * Sign-in: Microsoft Graph PowerShell SDK, delegated, in a browser
        (username, password, MFA). The SDK's token is handed to a compiled
        .NET engine and refreshed automatically for the rest of the run.
      * Windows are sized from observed record density to stay well under the
        ~1,000,000-records-per-search cap; any search the service flags as
        over the cap is split BEFORE it is downloaded.
      * Stays under the tenant's rolling daily submission budget (~200 per 24h,
        shared tenant-wide) and the concurrent-search limit.
      * Page downloads run in parallel under an adaptive limit: it steps up
        while clean, halves on any 429, and every stream waits out Retry-After.
      * SQL loading runs alongside the downloads - several SqlBulkCopy
        writers into a heap with TABLOCK (bulk-update locks, minimal logging).
      * All state lives in SQL (audit.CopilotBackfillWindow). Ctrl+C, a crash
        or a reboot loses nothing: run the same command again to resume.

    After the backfill, -Finalize builds audit.CopilotAudit (columnstore,
    deduplicated) and audit.CopilotInteraction (shredded, for reporting).

.PARAMETER SqlServer
    SQL Server instance, e.g. SQLPROD01 or SQLPROD01\INST1 or sql.contoso.com,1433.

.PARAMETER Database
    Target database. The script creates the 'audit' schema objects it needs.

.PARAMETER SqlCredential
    SQL authentication. Omit to use Windows integrated authentication.

.PARAMETER TrustServerCertificate
    Encrypt the SQL connection without validating the server certificate. Use
    only when the instance presents a self-signed certificate.

.PARAMETER ConnectionString
    Full connection string; overrides -SqlServer/-Database/-SqlCredential.

.PARAMETER StartDate
    UTC. Defaults to 365 days before -EndDate. Copilot audit records are kept
    for 180 days unless a custom audit retention policy covering them was in
    place - check Get-UnifiedAuditLogRetentionPolicy before asking for more.

.PARAMETER EndDate
    UTC. Defaults to the start of today (UTC), so no partially ingested day is
    captured. Keep the data current from there with scheduled -Incremental runs.

.PARAMETER TenantId
    Tenant GUID or contoso.onmicrosoft.com. Strongly recommended: pins sign-in
    to the right tenant.

.PARAMETER AuthMode
    Browser (default) or DeviceCode (server with no usable browser: sign in
    from any other device at https://microsoft.com/devicelogin).

.PARAMETER Finalize
    After the backfill completes, build the final and reporting tables.

.PARAMETER FinalizeOnly
    Skip the backfill; just run the finalize step.

.PARAMETER Status
    Print the backfill's saved progress and exit (safe while a run is active).

.PARAMETER Incremental
    Keep a finalized database current: load from the end of the previous load
    (or of the backfill) up to the start of the current hour, then append the
    new records to audit.CopilotAudit and audit.CopilotInteraction with
    audit.usp_MergeCopilotLoad - no rebuild. Meant to run on a schedule. A load
    interrupted part-way resumes on the next run. -StartDate is ignored; pass
    -EndDate only to stop short of now.

.PARAMETER LookbackHours
    With -Incremental: how far before the previous load's end each load starts
    again (default 48). Purview can deliver a record hours after the event, so
    the overlap is searched again; records already loaded are counted and
    skipped, never duplicated.

.PARAMETER SkipPostProcessing
    With -Incremental: only load and merge. By default the run then brings the
    derived tables up to date as well, for each one installed: the flattened
    table (usp_FlattenCopilotAudit, from the load's start), license events
    (usp_ShredLicenseEvents), sessions (usp_BuildCopilotSessions) and the bi
    star schema (bi.usp_RefreshBi, from the load's start). A refresh that is
    skipped, or stops part way, stays owed (audit.CopilotLoad.DerivedRefreshedUtc
    is left empty): the next run without this switch refreshes from the
    earliest load or CSV import that owes one, even when there is nothing new
    to load.

.PARAMETER SessionLicenseDatabase
    With -Incremental: passed to usp_BuildCopilotSessions and bi.usp_RefreshBi
    as @LicenseEventDatabase (one database, or several comma-separated), so
    each session and interaction carries the license held at the time.

.PARAMETER RecordTypes
    Purview record types to load whole (2.6.9), for example
    ConnectedAIAppInteraction, PowerBIAudit and PowerAppsApp: the activity
    database. Without -Operations, no operation filter is sent. The database
    records them as rt:<type> beside its operations, so it keeps one set: use
    a database of its own, never the Copilot or license database.

.PARAMETER CertificateThumbprint
    App-only sign-in, for a scheduled run with nobody to sign in: the
    thumbprint of a certificate in the CurrentUser or LocalMachine store whose
    public key is uploaded to the app registration given by -ClientId. The app
    needs the Microsoft Graph APPLICATION permission AuditLogsQuery.Read.All,
    admin-consented. Requires -ClientId and -TenantId.

.EXAMPLE
    .\Invoke-CopilotAuditBackfill.ps1 -SqlServer SQLPROD01 -Database CopilotAudit -TenantId contoso.onmicrosoft.com

.EXAMPLE
    # Resume after Ctrl+C / reboot: the same command again.
    .\Invoke-CopilotAuditBackfill.ps1 -SqlServer SQLPROD01 -Database CopilotAudit -TenantId contoso.onmicrosoft.com -Finalize

.EXAMPLE
    # Daily, from Task Scheduler, once the backfill is finalized: app-only sign-in.
    .\Invoke-CopilotAuditBackfill.ps1 -SqlServer SQLPROD01 -Database CopilotAudit -Incremental `
        -TenantId contoso.onmicrosoft.com -ClientId <app-id> -CertificateThumbprint <thumbprint>

.EXAMPLE
    # Smoke test first: one day.
    .\Invoke-CopilotAuditBackfill.ps1 -SqlServer SQLDEV01 -Database CopilotAuditTest -TenantId contoso.onmicrosoft.com `
        -StartDate (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().Date.AddDays(-2) -EndDate (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().Date.AddDays(-1) -Finalize
#>

#Requires -Version 7.2

[CmdletBinding(DefaultParameterSetName = 'Server')]
param(
    [Parameter(ParameterSetName = 'Server')] [string] $SqlServer,
    [Parameter(ParameterSetName = 'Server')] [string] $Database,
    [Parameter(ParameterSetName = 'Server')] [pscredential] $SqlCredential,
    [Parameter(ParameterSetName = 'Server')] [switch] $TrustServerCertificate,
    [Parameter(ParameterSetName = 'ConnStr')] [string] $ConnectionString,

    [datetime] $StartDate,
    [datetime] $EndDate,

    [string]   $TenantId,
    [ValidateSet('Browser', 'DeviceCode')]
    [string]   $AuthMode = 'Browser',
    [string]   $ClientId,
    [string]   $CertificateThumbprint,

    [string[]] $Operations = @('CopilotInteraction'),
    [string[]] $RecordTypes,

    [switch]   $Finalize,
    [switch]   $FinalizeOnly,
    [switch]   $Status,

    [switch]   $Incremental,
    [ValidateRange(0, 168)]       [int]    $LookbackHours          = 48,
    [switch]   $SkipPostProcessing,
    [string]   $SessionLicenseDatabase,

    # --- tuning (defaults are deliberately inside Microsoft's published limits)
    [ValidateRange(1, 32)]        [int]    $MaxDownloadStreams     = 8,
    [ValidateRange(1, 32)]        [int]    $InitialDownloadStreams = 4,
    [ValidateRange(1, 40)]        [int]    $MaxQueriesInFlight     = 8,
    [ValidateRange(1, 200)]       [int]    $MaxSubmissionsPer24h   = 150,
    [ValidateRange(30, 1440)]     [int]    $QueryTimeoutMinutes    = 240,
    [ValidateRange(10000, 5000000)][long]  $TargetRecordsPerWindow = 600000,
    [ValidateRange(0.25, 168)]    [double] $InitialWindowHours     = 24,
    [ValidateRange(1, 16)]        [int]    $SqlWriters             = 4,
    [ValidateRange(100, 50000)]   [int]    $BatchRows              = 2000,
    [ValidateRange(10, 1000)]     [int]    $PageSize               = 1000,

    [string]   $LogPath
)

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

# A record-type load asks for whole record types, and for no operation unless -Operations is given too.
if ($RecordTypes -and -not $PSBoundParameters.ContainsKey('Operations')) { $Operations = @() }

# A 'Modules' folder next to this script takes precedence over the machine's
# module paths. That is how a server with no PSGallery access gets
# Microsoft.Graph.Authentication (tools\Save-CopilotAuditModules.ps1); when the
# folder is absent this does nothing and module resolution is unchanged.
$script:BundledModules = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'Modules'
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $script:BundledModules -PathType Container) {
    $sep = [System.IO.Path]::PathSeparator
    $existing = ($env:PSModulePath -split [regex]::Escape($sep)) | Where-Object { $_ -ne $script:BundledModules }
    $env:PSModulePath = (@($script:BundledModules) + $existing) -join $sep
}

. (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'Import-CopilotAuditEngine.ps1')

# ===========================================================================
# Logging
# ===========================================================================

$script:LogFile = $null

function Write-LogLine {
    param([string] $Line)
    $color = if ($Line -match '\[ERROR\]') { 'Red' } elseif ($Line -match '\[WARN') { 'Yellow' } else { $null }
    if ($Line -match '\[DEBUG\]') { Write-Verbose $Line }
    elseif ($color) { Write-Host $Line -ForegroundColor $color }
    else { Write-Host $Line }
    if ($script:LogFile) { [System.IO.File]::AppendAllText($script:LogFile, $Line + [Environment]::NewLine) }
}

function Write-Log {
    param([Parameter(Mandatory)][string] $Message, [ValidateSet('INFO', 'WARN', 'ERROR', 'DEBUG')][string] $Level = 'INFO')
    Write-LogLine ('{0:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss}Z [{1,-5}] {2}' -f [datetime]::UtcNow, $Level, $Message)
}

# ===========================================================================
# SQL helpers
# ===========================================================================

function New-SqlConnectionString {
    # Built from the string, not assigned afterwards: the builder is a
    # DbConnectionStringBuilder, and PowerShell routes $b.ConnectionString = x
    # through its keyword indexer, which rejects 'ConnectionString' as a
    # keyword. The constructor overload is the only form that works.
    $csb = if ($ConnectionString) {
        [System.Data.SqlClient.SqlConnectionStringBuilder]::new($ConnectionString)
    }
    else {
        [System.Data.SqlClient.SqlConnectionStringBuilder]::new()
    }
    if (-not $ConnectionString) {
        if (-not $SqlServer -or -not $Database) { throw 'Specify -SqlServer and -Database (or -ConnectionString).' }
        $csb['Data Source'] = $SqlServer
        $csb['Initial Catalog'] = $Database
        if ($SqlCredential) {
            $csb['User ID'] = $SqlCredential.UserName
            $csb['Password'] = $SqlCredential.GetNetworkCredential().Password
        }
        else {
            $csb['Integrated Security'] = $true
        }
        $csb['Encrypt'] = $true
        $csb['TrustServerCertificate'] = [bool] $TrustServerCertificate
    }
    $csb['Application Name'] = 'CopilotAuditBackfill'
    if ($csb['Max Pool Size'] -lt ($SqlWriters * 2 + 10)) { $csb['Max Pool Size'] = $SqlWriters * 2 + 10 }
    return $csb.ConnectionString
}

function Invoke-Sql {
    <#
        Runs one batch. -As NonQuery | Scalar | Table. PRINT / RAISERROR(0)
        messages are logged live.
    #>
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory)][string] $Sql,
        [ValidateSet('NonQuery', 'Scalar', 'Table')][string] $As = 'NonQuery',
        [hashtable] $Parameters = @{},
        [int] $TimeoutSeconds = 120
    )
    $conn = [System.Data.SqlClient.SqlConnection]::new($script:SqlConnStr)
    $conn.add_InfoMessage({ param($source, $e) foreach ($m in $e.Errors) { Write-Log ("SQL: " + $m.Message) } })
    try {
        $conn.Open()
        $cmd = $conn.CreateCommand()
        $cmd.CommandText = $Sql
        $cmd.CommandTimeout = $TimeoutSeconds
        foreach ($k in $Parameters.Keys) {
            $v = $Parameters[$k]
            [void] $cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue($k, $(if ($null -eq $v) { [DBNull]::Value } else { $v }))
        }
        switch ($As) {
            'Scalar' { return $cmd.ExecuteScalar() }
            'Table'  {
                $dt = [System.Data.DataTable]::new()
                $reader = $cmd.ExecuteReader()
                try { $dt.Load($reader) } finally { $reader.Dispose() }
                return ,$dt
            }
            default  { [void] $cmd.ExecuteNonQuery() }
        }
    }
    finally { $conn.Dispose() }
}

function Invoke-SqlScript {
    <#
        Runs a script file that uses GO batch separators, as the stored
        procedure scripts do (CREATE/ALTER PROCEDURE must start a batch).
        Splits the way sqlcmd does: GO alone on a line. \r? because a Windows
        checkout has CRLF endings and .NET's multiline $ matches before \n only.
    #>
    param([Parameter(Mandatory)][string] $Path, [int] $TimeoutSeconds = 600)
    $text = Get-Content -LiteralPath $Path -Raw
    foreach ($batch in [regex]::Split($text, '(?im)^[ \t]*GO[ \t]*(?:--[^\r\n]*)?\r?$')) {
        if (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($batch)) { Invoke-Sql -Sql $batch -TimeoutSeconds $TimeoutSeconds }
    }
}

function Initialize-CopilotAuditDatabase {
    try {
        Invoke-Sql -Sql 'SELECT 1' -As Scalar | Out-Null
    }
    catch {
        $m = $_.Exception.GetBaseException().Message
        if ($m -match 'certificate') {
            throw "Could not connect to SQL Server: $m`nIf the instance uses a self-signed certificate, add -TrustServerCertificate."
        }
        throw "Could not connect to SQL Server: $m"
    }
    Invoke-Sql -Sql (Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'sql' 'Create-CopilotAuditSchema.sql') -Raw)
    Write-Log 'SQL schema ready (audit.CopilotBackfillRange / CopilotBackfillWindow / CopilotAuditStage).'
}

function Enter-RunLock {
    <#
        Holds the database for this run alone, as the nightly pipeline, Install-CopilotAudit.ps1 and the
        maintenance rebuilds do: an exclusive application lock, on a connection of its own kept open to the end of the
        run. A load run by hand (-Incremental, or a history range) took none, so it could run beside the nightly and
        load the same windows twice. As one of the pipeline's own steps, the pipeline holds it already
        (CopilotAuditRunLock). Returns the connection (dispose it to let go), or nothing under the pipeline's lock.
    #>
    $b = [System.Data.SqlClient.SqlConnectionStringBuilder]::new($script:SqlConnStr)
    if ($env:CopilotAuditRunLock -eq "$($b['Data Source'])/$($b['Initial Catalog'])") { return $null }
    $b['Pooling'] = $false   # closing a pooled connection keeps its session, and the session's lock with it
    $c = [System.Data.SqlClient.SqlConnection]::new($b.ConnectionString)
    try {
        $c.Open()
        $cmd = $c.CreateCommand()
        $cmd.CommandText = "DECLARE @r INT; EXEC @r = sp_getapplock @Resource = N'CopilotAudit.Run', @LockMode = 'Exclusive', @LockOwner = 'Session', @LockTimeout = 0; SELECT @r;"
        $granted = [int] $cmd.ExecuteScalar() -ge 0
    }
    catch { $c.Dispose(); throw }
    if (-not $granted) {
        $c.Dispose()
        throw "Another run is using $($b['Initial Catalog']) now: the nightly pipeline, the installer, a maintenance rebuild or another load. Nothing was loaded. Let it finish (Admin > Health shows the pipeline's runs), then run this again."
    }
    $c
}

function ConvertTo-UtcDate {
    param([Parameter(Mandatory)][datetime] $Value)
    switch ($Value.Kind) {
        'Utc'   { return $Value }
        'Local' { return $Value.ToUniversalTime() }
        default { return [datetime]::SpecifyKind($Value, [DateTimeKind]::Utc) }   # -StartDate 2025-09-22 means UTC
    }
}

function Get-AuditFilterSet {
    <#
        What a database records it loads: its operations, and each
        whole record type as rt:<type>, so a record-type database can never be
        resumed or loaded with operations, nor the other way round. Pure, for
        the tests.
    #>
    param([string[]] $Operations, [string[]] $RecordTypes)
    $set = @($Operations | Where-Object { $_ } | ForEach-Object { $_.Trim() }) +
           @($RecordTypes | Where-Object { $_ } | ForEach-Object { 'rt:' + $_.Trim() })
    if ($set.Count -eq 0) { throw 'Nothing to load: give -Operations or -RecordTypes.' }
    , [string[]] @($set | Sort-Object -Unique)
}

function Resolve-BackfillRange {
    <#
        First run: records the requested range. Later runs: the stored range
        wins (so a resume never needs the original dates re-typed), except that
        an earlier -StartDate extends it.
    #>
    $ops = (Get-AuditFilterSet -Operations $Operations -RecordTypes $RecordTypes) -join ','
    $existing = Invoke-Sql -As Table -Sql 'SELECT RangeStartUtc, RangeEndUtc, Operations, CompletedUtc FROM audit.CopilotBackfillRange WHERE Id = 1'

    if ($existing.Rows.Count -eq 0) {
        $end = if ($EndDate) { ConvertTo-UtcDate $EndDate } else { [datetime]::UtcNow.Date }
        $start = if ($StartDate) { ConvertTo-UtcDate $StartDate } else { $end.AddDays(-365) }
        $start = [datetime]::new($start.Year, $start.Month, $start.Day, $start.Hour, $start.Minute, 0, [DateTimeKind]::Utc)
        $end   = [datetime]::new($end.Year, $end.Month, $end.Day, $end.Hour, $end.Minute, 0, [DateTimeKind]::Utc)
        if ($start -ge $end) { throw 'StartDate must be earlier than EndDate.' }

        Invoke-Sql -Sql 'INSERT INTO audit.CopilotBackfillRange (Id, RangeStartUtc, RangeEndUtc, Operations) VALUES (1, @s, @e, @o)' `
                   -Parameters @{ '@s' = $start; '@e' = $end; '@o' = $ops }
        Write-Log ('New backfill: {0:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm}Z -> {1:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm}Z ({2:N0} days), operations {3}.' -f $start, $end, ($end - $start).TotalDays, $ops)
        return [pscustomobject]@{ Start = $start; End = $end; Resumed = $false; Completed = $false }
    }

    $row = $existing.Rows[0]
    $start = [datetime]::SpecifyKind($row.RangeStartUtc, [DateTimeKind]::Utc)
    $end   = [datetime]::SpecifyKind($row.RangeEndUtc, [DateTimeKind]::Utc)
    if ($row.Operations -ne $ops) {
        throw "This database holds a backfill of '$($row.Operations)', not '$ops'. Use a separate database for other operations."
    }
    if ($StartDate -and (ConvertTo-UtcDate $StartDate) -lt $start) {
        $start = ConvertTo-UtcDate $StartDate
        Invoke-Sql -Sql 'UPDATE audit.CopilotBackfillRange SET RangeStartUtc = @s, CompletedUtc = NULL WHERE Id = 1' -Parameters @{ '@s' = $start }
        Write-Log ('Extending the backfill back to {0:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm}Z.' -f $start)
        $completed = $false
    }
    else {
        if ($StartDate -and (ConvertTo-UtcDate $StartDate) -ne $start) {
            Write-Log ('-StartDate ignored: this backfill started at {0:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm}Z (only an earlier start can be added).' -f $start) -Level WARN
        }
        $completed = $row.CompletedUtc -isnot [DBNull]
    }
    if ($EndDate -and (ConvertTo-UtcDate $EndDate) -ne $end) {
        Write-Log ('-EndDate ignored: this backfill ends at {0:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm}Z. Use a separate database for a different end.' -f $end) -Level WARN
    }
    Write-Log ('Resuming backfill {0:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm}Z -> {1:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm}Z.' -f $start, $end)
    return [pscustomobject]@{ Start = $start; End = $end; Resumed = $true; Completed = $completed }
}

function Show-BackfillState {
    $range = Invoke-Sql -As Table -Sql 'SELECT RangeStartUtc, RangeEndUtc, Operations, StartedUtc, CompletedUtc FROM audit.CopilotBackfillRange WHERE Id = 1'
    if ($range.Rows.Count -eq 0) { Write-Log 'No backfill recorded in this database yet.'; return }
    $r = $range.Rows[0]
    Write-Log ('Range {0:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm}Z -> {1:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm}Z | {2} | {3}' -f $r.RangeStartUtc, $r.RangeEndUtc, $r.Operations,
               $(if ($r.CompletedUtc -is [DBNull]) { 'not complete' } else { 'completed {0:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm}Z' -f $r.CompletedUtc }))

    $w = Invoke-Sql -As Table -Sql @'
SELECT Status, COUNT(*) AS Windows, SUM(ISNULL(RowsLoaded, 0)) AS RowsLoaded,
       CAST(SUM(DATEDIFF(MINUTE, StartUtc, EndUtc)) / 60.0 AS DECIMAL(12,1)) AS Hours
FROM audit.CopilotBackfillWindow GROUP BY Status ORDER BY Status
'@
    foreach ($row in $w.Rows) {
        Write-Log ('  {0,-12} {1,6:N0} windows  {2,7:N1} h  {3,14:N0} rows' -f $row.Status, $row.Windows, $row.Hours, $row.RowsLoaded)
    }
    $stage = Invoke-Sql -As Scalar -Sql "SELECT SUM(rows) FROM sys.partitions WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'audit.CopilotAuditStage') AND index_id IN (0, 1)"
    Write-Log ('  staging table holds ~{0:N0} rows (including superseded attempts)' -f $stage)

    $loads = Invoke-Sql -As Table -Sql @'
SELECT TOP (5) LoadId, RangeStartUtc, RangeEndUtc, DownloadedUtc, MergedUtc, RowsAdded, RowsAlreadyLoaded
FROM audit.CopilotLoad ORDER BY LoadId DESC
'@
    if ($loads.Rows.Count -gt 0) {
        Write-Log 'Incremental loads (latest first):'
        foreach ($l in $loads.Rows) {
            $state = if ($l.MergedUtc -isnot [DBNull]) { 'merged {0:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm}Z, {1:N0} new, {2:N0} already loaded' -f $l.MergedUtc, $l.RowsAdded, $l.RowsAlreadyLoaded }
                     elseif ($l.DownloadedUtc -isnot [DBNull]) { 'downloaded, not yet merged' }
                     else { 'in progress' }
            Write-Log ('  #{0,-4} {1:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm}Z -> {2:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm}Z  {3}' -f $l.LoadId, $l.RangeStartUtc, $l.RangeEndUtc, $state)
        }
    }
}

function Invoke-CopilotAuditFinalize {
    # An activity database builds no audit.CopilotInteraction (Finalize-CopilotAudit.sql); its own shred follows.
    $activity = [bool] (Invoke-Sql -As Scalar -Sql "SELECT CASE WHEN OBJECT_ID(N'audit.usp_ShredActivity', N'P') IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END")
    Write-Log ('Finalizing: verifying coverage, building audit.CopilotAudit' + $(if ($activity) { ' (an activity database: its own shred follows)...' } else { ' and audit.CopilotInteraction...' }))
    $sql = Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'sql' 'Finalize-CopilotAudit.sql') -Raw
    try {
        $summary = Invoke-Sql -As Table -Sql $sql -TimeoutSeconds 0
    }
    catch {
        throw ('Finalize stopped: ' + $_.Exception.GetBaseException().Message)
    }
    if ($summary.Rows.Count -gt 0) {
        $s = $summary.Rows[0]
        Write-Log ('Final: {0:N0} records | {1:N0} duplicates removed | {2:yyyy-MM-dd} -> {3:yyyy-MM-dd} | {4:N0} users' -f `
                   $s.FinalRows, $s.DuplicatesRemoved, $s.OldestRecordUtc, $s.NewestRecordUtc, $s.DistinctUsers)
    }
    # An activity database's history is shredded once it is final, so the rollup that follows has it.
    if ([bool] (Invoke-Sql -As Scalar -Sql "SELECT CASE WHEN OBJECT_ID(N'audit.usp_ShredActivity', N'P') IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END")) {
        Write-Log 'Shredding every AI app, Power BI and Power Apps record...'
        Invoke-Sql -Sql 'EXEC audit.usp_ShredActivity;' -TimeoutSeconds 0
    }
}

# ===========================================================================
# Incremental loads
# ===========================================================================

function Get-OperationsChange {
    <#
        Whether a load may ask for these operations in a database that recorded
        others: the operations it adds (none when they are the same), or $null
        when it would drop one. Pure, for the tests.
    #>
    param([string] $Recorded, [string[]] $Requested)
    $had = @($Recorded -split ',' | ForEach-Object { $_.Trim() } | Where-Object { $_ })
    $want = @($Requested | ForEach-Object { $_.Trim() } | Where-Object { $_ } | Sort-Object -Unique)
    if (@($had | Where-Object { $_ -notin $want }).Count -gt 0) { return $null }
    , @($want | Where-Object { $_ -notin $had })
}

function Resolve-LoadRange {
    <#
        The next incremental load's range, from where the data ends. It starts
        LookbackHours earlier, because Purview can deliver a record hours after
        the event and the overlap must be searched again. It ends at EndUtc if
        given, else at the start of the current hour - a whole hour, so a load
        never catches an hour half-ingested and misses its tail. Returns $null
        when there is nothing after BaseEndUtc to load.
    #>
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory)][datetime] $BaseEndUtc,
        [Parameter(Mandatory)][datetime] $NowUtc,
        [int] $LookbackHours = 48,
        [Nullable[datetime]] $EndUtc
    )
    # PowerShell hands a [Nullable[datetime]] over already unwrapped: no .Value.
    $e = if ($null -ne $EndUtc) { [datetime] $EndUtc } else { $NowUtc }
    $end = if ($null -ne $EndUtc) {
        [datetime]::new($e.Year, $e.Month, $e.Day, $e.Hour, $e.Minute, 0, [DateTimeKind]::Utc)
    } else {
        [datetime]::new($e.Year, $e.Month, $e.Day, $e.Hour, 0, 0, [DateTimeKind]::Utc)
    }
    $base = [datetime]::SpecifyKind($BaseEndUtc, [DateTimeKind]::Utc)
    if ($end -le $base) { return $null }
    return [pscustomobject]@{ Start = $base.AddHours(-$LookbackHours); End = $end }
}

function Get-IncrementalLoad {
    <#
        The load to work on: the unfinished one if a previous run stopped, else
        a new one continuing from the last merged load - or, the first time,
        from the end of the finalized backfill.
    #>
    $filters = Get-AuditFilterSet -Operations $Operations -RecordTypes $RecordTypes
    $ops = $filters -join ','

    $pending = Invoke-Sql -As Table -Sql 'SELECT TOP (1) LoadId, RangeStartUtc, RangeEndUtc, Operations, DownloadedUtc FROM audit.CopilotLoad WHERE MergedUtc IS NULL ORDER BY LoadId'
    if ($pending.Rows.Count -gt 0) {
        $p = $pending.Rows[0]
        $widen = Get-OperationsChange -Recorded $p.Operations -Requested $filters
        if ($null -eq $widen) { throw "Load $($p.LoadId) in this database is of '$($p.Operations)', not '$ops'." }
        if ($widen.Count -gt 0) {
            Invoke-Sql -Sql 'UPDATE audit.CopilotLoad SET Operations = @o WHERE LoadId = @id' -Parameters @{ '@o' = $ops; '@id' = [int] $p.LoadId }
            Write-Log "Load $($p.LoadId) now also asks for: $($widen -join ', ')."
        }
        $downloaded = $p.DownloadedUtc -isnot [DBNull]
        $load = [pscustomobject]@{
            LoadId = [int] $p.LoadId
            Start = [datetime]::SpecifyKind($p.RangeStartUtc, [DateTimeKind]::Utc)
            End = [datetime]::SpecifyKind($p.RangeEndUtc, [DateTimeKind]::Utc)
            Downloaded = $downloaded
        }
        Write-Log ('Resuming load {0}: {1:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm}Z -> {2:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm}Z{3}.' -f $load.LoadId, $load.Start, $load.End,
                   $(if ($downloaded) { ', already downloaded - merging' } else { '' }))
        return $load
    }

    $backfill = Invoke-Sql -As Table -Sql 'SELECT RangeEndUtc, Operations, CompletedUtc FROM audit.CopilotBackfillRange WHERE Id = 1'
    if ($backfill.Rows.Count -eq 0 -or $backfill.Rows[0].CompletedUtc -is [DBNull]) {
        throw 'Run a backfill to completion in this database first: incremental loads continue from where it ends.'
    }
    $added = Get-OperationsChange -Recorded $backfill.Rows[0].Operations -Requested $filters
    if ($null -eq $added) {
        throw "This database holds a backfill of '$($backfill.Rows[0].Operations)', not '$ops'. Pass the same -Operations, or more of them."
    }
    if ($added.Count -gt 0) {
        # 2.3.0 added Copilot Studio's authoring operations to the license-event load: they load from now on.
        Invoke-Sql -Sql 'UPDATE audit.CopilotBackfillRange SET Operations = @o WHERE Id = 1' -Parameters @{ '@o' = $ops }
        Write-Log "Loading $($added -join ', ') too from now on. Earlier records of them are not loaded into this database."
    }
    if ((Invoke-Sql -As Scalar -Sql "SELECT CASE WHEN OBJECT_ID(N'audit.CopilotAudit', N'U') IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END") -eq 0) {
        throw 'The backfill has not been finalized. Run -FinalizeOnly first: loads are appended to audit.CopilotAudit.'
    }

    $lastMerged = Invoke-Sql -As Scalar -Sql 'SELECT MAX(RangeEndUtc) FROM audit.CopilotLoad WHERE MergedUtc IS NOT NULL'
    $base = if ($null -eq $lastMerged -or $lastMerged -is [DBNull]) { $backfill.Rows[0].RangeEndUtc } else { $lastMerged }
    $endArg = if ($EndDate) { ConvertTo-UtcDate $EndDate } else { $null }
    $range = Resolve-LoadRange -BaseEndUtc $base -NowUtc ([datetime]::UtcNow) -LookbackHours $LookbackHours -EndUtc $endArg
    if (-not $range) {
        Write-Log ('Nothing to load: the data already reaches {0:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm}Z.' -f $base)
        return $null
    }

    # Leftovers from a load whose merge committed but whose clean-up did not.
    Invoke-Sql -Sql 'TRUNCATE TABLE audit.CopilotLoadStage; TRUNCATE TABLE audit.CopilotLoadWindow;'
    $id = Invoke-Sql -As Scalar -Parameters @{ '@s' = $range.Start; '@e' = $range.End; '@o' = $ops } -Sql @'
INSERT INTO audit.CopilotLoad (RangeStartUtc, RangeEndUtc, Operations) OUTPUT INSERTED.LoadId VALUES (@s, @e, @o);
'@
    Write-Log ('New load {0}: {1:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm}Z -> {2:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm}Z ({3:N0} h, the first {4} h a lookback over data already loaded).' -f `
               $id, $range.Start, $range.End, ($range.End - $range.Start).TotalHours, $LookbackHours)
    return [pscustomobject]@{ LoadId = [int] $id; Start = $range.Start; End = $range.End; Downloaded = $false }
}

function Invoke-DerivedTableRefresh {
    <#
        After a merge, brings each installed derived table up to date: the
        flattened table and license events from the load's start (both MERGE,
        so the lookback's records are updated in place), then sessions from
        the load's start's day (one transaction), then the bi star schema from
        the load's start, then the dashboard's rollups.
    #>
    param([Parameter(Mandatory)][datetime] $SinceUtc)
    function Test-Proc([string] $Name) {
        return [bool] (Invoke-Sql -As Scalar -Sql "SELECT CASE WHEN OBJECT_ID(N'$Name', N'P') IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END")
    }
    if (Test-Proc 'audit.usp_FlattenCopilotAudit') {
        Write-Log ('Flattening records from {0:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm}Z...' -f $SinceUtc)
        Invoke-Sql -Sql 'EXEC audit.usp_FlattenCopilotAudit @SinceUtc = @s;' -Parameters @{ '@s' = $SinceUtc } -TimeoutSeconds 0
    }
    if (Test-Proc 'audit.usp_ShredLicenseEvents') {
        Write-Log ('Shredding license events from {0:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm}Z...' -f $SinceUtc)
        Invoke-Sql -Sql 'EXEC audit.usp_ShredLicenseEvents @SinceUtc = @s;' -Parameters @{ '@s' = $SinceUtc } -TimeoutSeconds 0
    }
    if (Test-Proc 'audit.usp_ShredAgentEvents') {
        Write-Log ('Shredding agent build and publish events from {0:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm}Z...' -f $SinceUtc)
        Invoke-Sql -Sql 'EXEC audit.usp_ShredAgentEvents @SinceUtc = @s;' -Parameters @{ '@s' = $SinceUtc } -TimeoutSeconds 0
    }
    if (Test-Proc 'audit.usp_ShredActivity') {
        Write-Log ('Shredding AI app, Power BI and Power Apps activity from {0:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm}Z...' -f $SinceUtc)
        Invoke-Sql -Sql 'EXEC audit.usp_ShredActivity @SinceUtc = @s;' -Parameters @{ '@s' = $SinceUtc } -TimeoutSeconds 0
    }
    if (Test-Proc 'audit.usp_BuildCopilotSessions') {
        $licDb = $(if ($SessionLicenseDatabase) { $SessionLicenseDatabase } else { $null })
        # Incremental from the load's start where the installed procedure can
        # (it rebuilds only the days from then on); a version before it
        # rebuilds everything.
        $canIncrement = [bool] (Invoke-Sql -As Scalar -Sql "SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.parameters WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'audit.usp_BuildCopilotSessions') AND name = N'@SinceUtc') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END")
        if ($canIncrement) {
            Write-Log ('Rebuilding sessions and the weekly rollup from {0:yyyy-MM-dd}...' -f $SinceUtc)
            Invoke-Sql -Sql 'EXEC audit.usp_BuildCopilotSessions @LicenseEventDatabase = @l, @SinceUtc = @s;' `
                -Parameters @{ '@l' = $licDb; '@s' = $SinceUtc } -TimeoutSeconds 0
        }
        else {
            Write-Log 'Rebuilding every session and the weekly rollup (the installed procedure predates incremental builds)...'
            Invoke-Sql -Sql 'EXEC audit.usp_BuildCopilotSessions @LicenseEventDatabase = @l;' -Parameters @{ '@l' = $licDb } -TimeoutSeconds 0
        }
    }
    # Last: it reads the flattened rows, the sessions and the license events.
    if (Test-Proc 'bi.usp_RefreshBi') {
        Write-Log ('Refreshing the bi star schema from {0:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm}Z...' -f $SinceUtc)
        Invoke-Sql -Sql 'EXEC bi.usp_RefreshBi @SinceUtc = @s, @LicenseEventDatabase = @l;' `
            -Parameters @{ '@s' = $SinceUtc; '@l' = $(if ($SessionLicenseDatabase) { $SessionLicenseDatabase } else { $null }) } -TimeoutSeconds 0
    }
    # After bi: the Copilot Insights dashboard's org chart and daily rollups.
    if (Test-Proc 'dash.usp_RefreshDashboard') {
        Write-Log ('Refreshing the dashboard rollups from {0:yyyy-MM-dd}...' -f $SinceUtc)
        Invoke-Sql -Sql 'EXEC dash.usp_RefreshDashboard @SinceUtc = @s;' -Parameters @{ '@s' = $SinceUtc } -TimeoutSeconds 0
    }
}

function Get-OwedRefresh {
    <#
        Where the derived tables still owe a refresh: the start of the
        first merged load whose refresh did not finish (it failed after the
        merge, or ran with -SkipPostProcessing), or the earliest record of a CSV
        import whose own refresh did not. With the last load and import that
        covers, to mark them done after. $null when nothing is owed.
    #>
