using CopilotInsights.Data;
using CopilotInsights.Infrastructure;
using CopilotInsights.Pages;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication.Negotiate;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;

var builder = WebApplication.CreateBuilder(args);

builder.Services.Configure<InsightsOptions>(builder.Configuration.GetSection(InsightsOptions.Section));

var insights = builder.Configuration.GetSection(InsightsOptions.Section).Get<InsightsOptions>() ?? new InsightsOptions();
var entraSignIn = string.Equals(insights.Authentication?.Trim(), SignIn.Entra, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
/* Windows sign-in, the default. Under IIS the handler defers to IIS Windows authentication; under Kestrel (development)
   it negotiates itself. Or Entra ID, with Insights:Authentication = Entra (EntraSignIn). Every page needs a signed-in user. */
if (entraSignIn) EntraSignIn.Configure(builder.Services, insights, Governance.Web.Infrastructure.WorkbenchSetup.Enabled(builder.Configuration));
else builder.Services.AddAuthentication(NegotiateDefaults.AuthenticationScheme).AddNegotiate();
builder.Services.AddAuthorization(o => o.FallbackPolicy = new AuthorizationPolicyBuilder().RequireAuthenticatedUser().Build());
/* Grants to Entra groups are checked through Microsoft Graph, whichever way people sign in, once the app registration is set. */
builder.Services.AddSingleton<EntraGraph>();
/* Requests, failures and the site's warnings to Application Insights as well as the log, when a connection string is set. */
if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(insights.ApplicationInsightsConnectionString))
    builder.Services.AddApplicationInsightsTelemetry(o => o.ConnectionString = insights.ApplicationInsightsConnectionString.Trim());

builder.Services.AddMemoryCache();
builder.Services.AddHttpContextAccessor();
builder.Services.AddSingleton<TenantAccessor>();
/* The query cache in a store of its own, of a bounded size: the shared one has no limit. */
builder.Services.AddSingleton<SharedCache>();
builder.Services.AddSingleton(sp =>
{
    var o = sp.GetRequiredService<Microsoft.Extensions.Options.IOptions<InsightsOptions>>();
    /* Each server's own cache, with the one the web servers share behind it (SharedCache). */
    return new QueryCache(QueryCache.Store(o.Value.QueryCacheEntries), o, sp.GetRequiredService<ILogger<QueryCache>>()) { Shared = sp.GetRequiredService<SharedCache>() };
});
/* One set of form keys for every web server, where Insights:DataProtectionKeysPath names a share (KeyRing). */
var keyRing = KeyRing.Configure(builder.Services, insights);
builder.Services.AddSingleton<DataStamp>();
builder.Services.AddSingleton<Db>();
builder.Services.AddSingleton<Settings>();
builder.Services.AddSingleton<Freshness>();
builder.Services.AddScoped<ViewerService>();
builder.Services.AddScoped<ReportContextFactory>();
builder.Services.AddScoped<AuditLog>();
builder.Services.AddScoped<MostUsed>();
builder.Services.AddScoped<Metrics>();
builder.Services.AddScoped<PageServices>();
builder.Services.AddHttpClient();
builder.Services.AddSingleton<SecretStore>();
builder.Services.AddSingleton<Mailer>();
builder.Services.AddScoped<OpsData>();
builder.Services.AddScoped<OpsReports>();
builder.Services.AddScoped<CopilotInsights.Data.CostData>();
builder.Services.AddScoped<CopilotInsights.Data.SuiteData>();
builder.Services.AddScoped<CopilotInsights.Data.CreditData>();
builder.Services.AddScoped<CopilotInsights.Data.ReservationData>();
builder.Services.AddScoped<CopilotInsights.Data.CreditChargeData>();   // Credit chargeback and the commitment
builder.Services.AddScoped<CopilotInsights.Data.AssumptionData>();   // The assumptions register
/* A background service that fails is logged, and the site goes on: .NET's default stops the whole site,
   which a mail server that did not answer once did, again after every restart. */
builder.Services.Configure<HostOptions>(o => o.BackgroundServiceExceptionBehavior = BackgroundServiceExceptionBehavior.Ignore);
builder.Services.AddSingleton<Notifier>();
builder.Services.AddHostedService(sp => sp.GetRequiredService<Notifier>());
builder.Services.AddSingleton<PageWarmer>();
builder.Services.AddHostedService(sp => sp.GetRequiredService<PageWarmer>());
builder.Services.AddRazorPages(o => o.Conventions.ConfigureFilter(new Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.AutoValidateAntiforgeryTokenAttribute()));
/* The Governance Workbench, under /workbench, when ConnectionStrings:Governance names its database (WorkbenchSetup). */
Governance.Web.Infrastructure.WorkbenchSetup.AddWorkbench(builder);

var app = builder.Build();
if (keyRing is not null) app.Logger.LogInformation("Form keys shared by the web servers: {KeyRing}.", keyRing);

/* Under a virtual directory: IIS gives the application's path itself; behind another proxy, Insights:PathBase does. */
if (app.Services.GetRequiredService<Microsoft.Extensions.Options.IOptions<InsightsOptions>>().Value.PathBase is { Length: > 1 } pathBase)
    app.UsePathBase(pathBase);
app.UsePathBaseLinks();
/* Under IIS the base is only known per request: said once, at the first, when it is named as one of the site's own addresses. */
var clashSaid = 0;
app.Use(async (ctx, next) =>
{
    if (ctx.Request.PathBase.HasValue && Interlocked.Exchange(ref clashSaid, 1) == 0 && PathBaseLinks.Clashes(ctx.Request.PathBase.Value!))
        app.Logger.LogWarning("The site's virtual directory {PathBase} has the name of one of its own addresses: some links will not reach their page. Install it under another name.", ctx.Request.PathBase.Value);
    await next();
});

if (!app.Environment.IsDevelopment())
{
    app.UseExceptionHandler("/Error");
    app.UseHsts();
}

/* Everything the pages need comes from this site: no CDN, no inline script. */
app.Use(async (context, next) =>
{
    var h = context.Response.Headers;
    /* The Workbench's Teams tab is the one page another site may frame, and only Teams. */
    var teams = context.Request.Path.StartsWithSegments("/workbench/Teams/Launch", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
    var frame = teams ? "frame-ancestors https://teams.microsoft.com https://*.teams.microsoft.com https://*.cloud.microsoft https://*.skype.com https://*.office.com" : "frame-ancestors 'none'";
    h.ContentSecurityPolicy = $"default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; {frame}; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'";
    h.XContentTypeOptions = "nosniff";
    h["Referrer-Policy"] = "no-referrer";
    if (!teams) h["X-Frame-Options"] = "DENY";
    h.CacheControl = "no-store";
    await next();
});

/* An address with no page behind it (mistyped, or a bookmark to a page since moved) got an empty response, which
   a browser shows as a blank page. It is asked again as /not-found, which says so and offers the nearest reports; the
   answer is still 404. Only a page someone asked for: not the data API, not a file, not a form, and not a 404 that
   already came with a page of its own (a report turned off). */
app.Use(async (ctx, next) =>
{
    await next();
    var r = ctx.Response;
    if (r.StatusCode != StatusCodes.Status404NotFound || r.HasStarted || r.ContentLength is not null || !string.IsNullOrEmpty(r.ContentType)
        || !HttpMethods.IsGet(ctx.Request.Method) || ctx.Request.Path.StartsWithSegments("/api")
        || Path.HasExtension(ctx.Request.Path.Value) || ctx.Items.ContainsKey(CopilotInsights.Pages.NotFoundModel.AskedKey)) return;
    ctx.Items[CopilotInsights.Pages.NotFoundModel.AskedKey] = ctx.Request.Path.Value;
    ctx.SetEndpoint(null);
    ctx.Features.Get<Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http.Features.IRouteValuesFeature>()?.RouteValues?.Clear();
    ctx.Request.Path = "/not-found";
    ctx.Request.QueryString = QueryString.Empty;
    await next();
});

/* A Workbench page refused shows why (WorkbenchStatusPages), as a missing address does above. */
Governance.Web.Infrastructure.WorkbenchStatusPages.UseWorkbenchStatusPages(app);

/* Not the load balancer's probe: one that asks over HTTP, with TLS ended at the balancer, would be sent to HTTPS and
   count every server down. */
app.UseWhen(ctx => !ctx.Request.Path.StartsWithSegments(HealthProbe.Path), b => b.UseHttpsRedirection());
app.UseStaticFiles();
/* A page, a file or an API answer whose audit row could not be written is not served (AuditLog): 503, and why. */
app.Use(async (ctx, next) =>
{
    try { await next(); }
    catch (AuditLogUnavailableException) when (!ctx.Response.HasStarted)
    {
        ctx.Response.Headers.Remove("Content-Disposition");
        ctx.Response.StatusCode = StatusCodes.Status503ServiceUnavailable;
        ctx.Response.ContentType = "text/plain; charset=utf-8";
        await ctx.Response.WriteAsync(AuditLogUnavailableException.Message503);
    }
});
app.UseRouting();
app.UseAuthentication();
Governance.Web.Infrastructure.WorkbenchSetup.UseWorkbench(app);
app.UseAuthorization();
/* A Workbench address is always in the Workbench's own tenant (WorkbenchSetup.SelectTenantAsync). */
app.Use((ctx, next) => Governance.Web.Infrastructure.WorkbenchSetup.SelectTenantAsync(ctx, () => next()));
/* The dashboard's level limit, behind every endpoint that is not a page: pages refuse with
   their own message (InsightsPage), the data API with its own; anything else added later is covered here. */
app.Use(async (ctx, next) =>
{
    if (ctx.GetEndpoint() is { } ep && ep.Metadata.GetMetadata<Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.RazorPages.PageActionDescriptor>() is null
        && !ctx.Request.Path.StartsWithSegments("/api") && !ctx.Request.Path.StartsWithSegments(HealthProbe.Path))
    {
        var viewer = await ctx.RequestServices.GetRequiredService<ViewerService>().GetAsync();
        if (!viewer.Admitted && !viewer.AnyAdmin)
        {
            await ctx.RequestServices.GetRequiredService<AuditLog>().WriteAsync(viewer, "Denied", ctx.Request.Path, null, "outside the dashboard's levels");
            ctx.Response.StatusCode = 403;
            return;
        }
    }
    await next();
});
app.MapRazorPages();
/* Health moved from /admin, which servers often block, to /admin/health; old links still arrive. */
app.MapGet("/admin", () => Results.Redirect("/admin/health"));
/* The Workbench's home is its Start page; /workbench on its own was a page not found. */
app.MapGet("/workbench", () => Results.Redirect("/workbench/Start"));
/* My Copilot's pages are gone: links to them in earlier emails land on the start page. */
app.MapGet("/me/{**rest}", () => Results.Redirect("/"));
/* Pages merged in 2.7.6: the old addresses (bookmarks, emails, alerts) land on the page that took them, their query kept. */
static IResult Moved(HttpRequest r, string to, string? add = null)
{
    var q = string.Join("&", new[] { r.QueryString.HasValue ? r.QueryString.Value![1..] : null, add }.Where(x => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(x)));
    return Results.Redirect(q.Length == 0 ? to : to + "?" + q);
}
app.MapGet("/security/non-human", (HttpRequest r) => Moved(r, Nav.NonHuman));
app.MapGet("/compliance/non-human", (HttpRequest r) => Moved(r, Nav.NonHuman));
app.MapGet("/leadership/scorecard", (HttpRequest r) => Moved(r, "/leadership/boardpack"));
app.MapGet("/adoption/leaderboard", (HttpRequest r) => Moved(r, "/adoption/departments"));
app.MapGet("/agents/shared", (HttpRequest r) => Moved(r, "/agents/inventory", "show=shared"));
app.MapGet("/agents/production", (HttpRequest r) => Moved(r, "/agents/inventory", "show=production"));
app.MapDataApi();
/* A restricted viewer who sees the whole organization switches between their own reports and all of them. */
ViewChoice.Map(app);
/* Signed in through Entra ID, a way out: of the dashboard and of Entra ID, back to the start page. */
if (entraSignIn) app.MapGet(EntraSignIn.SignOutPath, EntraSignIn.SignOut);
/* The load balancer's probe: no sign-in, nothing named, only whether this server answers and reaches its database. */
app.MapMethods(HealthProbe.Path, ["GET", "HEAD"], HealthProbe.AnswerAsync).AllowAnonymous();

app.Run();

/// <summary>For the tests.</summary>
public partial class Program;

FILE: dashboard/CopilotInsights/Workbench/Principal.cs

using Dapper;
using Governance.Application;
using Governance.Application.Data;
using Governance.Domain;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using InsightsRoles = CopilotInsights.Infrastructure.Roles;
using ViewerService = CopilotInsights.Infrastructure.ViewerService;

namespace Governance.Web.Infrastructure;

public sealed record TestingOptions(bool TestAuthentication, bool AllowActAs);

public static class Policies
{
    public const string Central = "Central";
    public const string Operator = "Operator";
    public const string Admin = "Admin";
    public const string PlatformGovernance = "PlatformGovernance";
    public const string Auditor = "Auditor";
}

/// <summary>The person acting in this request, loaded once by <see cref="PrincipalMiddleware"/>.</summary>
public sealed class WebPrincipal : ICurrentPrincipal
{
    public bool IsAuthenticated { get; set; }
    public int PersonId { get; set; }
    public int? RealPersonId { get; set; }
    public string DisplayName { get; set; } = "";
    public string? RealDisplayName { get; set; }
    public string? Upn { get; set; }
    public Guid PublicId { get; set; }
    public bool IsCentral { get; set; }
    public IReadOnlyList<RoleGrant> Roles { get; set; } = Array.Empty<RoleGrant>();
    /// <summary>The Workbench page roles (AppRoles), from the person's Copilot Insights grants (<see cref="PrincipalLoader.PageRoles"/>).</summary>
    public IReadOnlySet<string> AppRoles { get; set; } = new HashSet<string>();
    public IReadOnlySet<string> Permissions { get; set; } = new HashSet<string>();
    public IReadOnlyDictionary<int, IReadOnlySet<string>> ScopedPermissions { get; set; } = new Dictionary<int, IReadOnlySet<string>>();
    public IReadOnlyList<(int FundingOwnerId, string Name)> FundingOwners { get; set; } = Array.Empty<(int, string)>();
    public IReadOnlyList<(string RoleCode, string Name, string? Scope)> RoleLabels { get; set; } = Array.Empty<(string, string, string?)>();
    public bool ActingAs => RealPersonId is not null;
    /// <summary>Development only: the signed-in person (not a persona) is an Insights administrator and may act as a test persona.</summary>
    public bool CanActAs { get; set; }
    public bool HasCentral(params string[] roles) => roles.Any(r => Roles.Any(g => g.RoleCode == r));
}

/// <summary>
/// Maps the person Copilot Insights signed in (Windows or Entra ID) to sec.Person, creating it on first visit, and
/// loads their Workbench roles. Which Workbench pages they may open comes from their Insights grants (Admin › Access);
/// the work they may do on those pages (RACI roles, delegations, LOB seat admin) from the Workbench's own records.
/// </summary>
public sealed class PrincipalLoader(Db db, ViewerService viewers, TestingOptions testing, ILogger<PrincipalLoader> log)
{
    public const string ActAsCookie = "cgw.actas";

    /// <summary>The Workbench page roles a set of Insights roles gives. Pure, for the tests.</summary>
    public static HashSet<string> PageRoles(IReadOnlySet<string> insightsRoles)
    {
        bool Has(string r) => insightsRoles.Contains(r);
        var set = new HashSet<string> { AppRoles.User };
        if (Has(InsightsRoles.Governance) || Has(InsightsRoles.GovernanceOperator)) set.Add(AppRoles.Central);
        if (Has(InsightsRoles.GovernanceOperator)) set.Add(AppRoles.Operator);
        if (Has(InsightsRoles.GovernanceAuditor)) set.Add(AppRoles.Auditor);
        if (Has(InsightsRoles.Admin)) set.Add(AppRoles.Admin);
        return set;
    }

    /// <param name="create">Records a person seen for the first time. The menu on Insights' pages only reads (false).</param>
    public async Task LoadAsync(HttpContext http, WebPrincipal p, bool create = true)
    {
        if (http.User.Identity?.IsAuthenticated != true) return;
        var viewer = await viewers.GetAsync();
        /* A person is their Entra object ID or their UPN, as the directory records them. A Windows account the directory
           has not matched yet has neither: it gets no Workbench person (one made from the sign-in name would hold a
           DOMAIN\name as its address, and split from the real person once the directory matches them). */
        var upn = viewer.Upn;
        Guid? oid = CopilotInsights.Infrastructure.EntraClaims.IsEntra(http.User) ? CopilotInsights.Infrastructure.EntraClaims.ObjectId(http.User)
                  : upn is null ? null : await viewers.ObjectIdOfAsync(upn);
        if (oid is null && string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(upn))
        {
            log.LogInformation("{Name} is not in the directory yet (no UPN or object ID): no Workbench person.", viewer.Name);
            return;
        }

        await using var c = await db.OpenAsync(0, true, http.RequestAborted);
        var person = await FindOrCreateAsync(c, oid, upn, viewer.Name, create, log);
        if (person is null) return;
        if (!person.AccountEnabled) { log.LogWarning("Disabled account {PersonId} signed in", person.PersonId); return; }

        var real = person;
        var realAppRoles = PageRoles(viewer.Roles);
        // Development-only persona switch, for a signed-in administrator only.
        p.CanActAs = testing.AllowActAs && realAppRoles.Contains(AppRoles.Admin);

        // Act as a synthetic test persona; every action records the real person.
        if (p.CanActAs && http.Request.Cookies.TryGetValue(ActAsCookie, out var actAs) && Guid.TryParse(actAs, out var personaId))
        {
            var persona = await c.QuerySingleOrDefaultAsync<Person>("SELECT * FROM sec.Person WHERE PublicId = @personaId AND IsSynthetic = 1 AND AccountEnabled = 1", new { personaId });
            if (persona is not null && persona.PersonId != real.PersonId)
            {
                p.RealPersonId = real.PersonId;
                p.RealDisplayName = real.DisplayName;
                person = persona;
            }
        }

        var today = DateTime.UtcNow.Date;
        var roles = (await c.QueryAsync<(string RoleCode, string ScopeType, int? ScopeId, bool IsCentral, string Name, string? ScopeName)>(
            """
            SELECT ra.RoleCode, ra.ScopeType, ra.ScopeId, rd.IsCentral, rd.Name, fo.Name
            FROM sec.RoleAssignment ra JOIN sec.RoleDefinition rd ON rd.RoleCode = ra.RoleCode
            LEFT JOIN core.FundingOwner fo ON fo.FundingOwnerId = ra.ScopeId
            WHERE ra.PersonId = @PersonId AND ra.EffectiveFrom <= @today AND (ra.EffectiveTo IS NULL OR ra.EffectiveTo >= @today)
            """, new { person.PersonId, today })).ToList();
        var perms = (await c.QueryAsync<(string RoleCode, string Permission)>("SELECT RoleCode, Permission FROM sec.RolePermission")).ToLookup(x => x.RoleCode, x => x.Permission);
        var delegations = (await c.QueryAsync<(int FundingOwnerId, string Name)>(
            """
            SELECT DISTINCT d.FundingOwnerId, fo.Name FROM sec.Delegation d JOIN core.FundingOwner fo ON fo.FundingOwnerId = d.FundingOwnerId
            WHERE d.DelegatePersonId = @PersonId AND d.Status = 'ACTIVE' AND d.EffectiveFrom <= @today AND (d.EffectiveTo IS NULL OR d.EffectiveTo >= @today)
            """, new { person.PersonId, today })).ToList();

        var tenant = new HashSet<string>();
        var scoped = new Dictionary<int, HashSet<string>>();
        foreach (var r in roles)
        {
            if (r.ScopeType == ScopeTypes.Tenant) tenant.UnionWith(perms[r.RoleCode]);
            else if (r.ScopeId is int fo)
            {
                if (!scoped.TryGetValue(fo, out var set)) scoped[fo] = set = new HashSet<string>();
                set.UnionWith(perms[r.RoleCode]);
            }
        }
        foreach (var d in delegations)
        {
            if (!scoped.TryGetValue(d.FundingOwnerId, out var set)) scoped[d.FundingOwnerId] = set = new HashSet<string>();
            set.UnionWith(perms[Governance.Domain.Roles.DelegatedApprover]);
        }

        p.IsAuthenticated = true;
        p.PersonId = person.PersonId;
        p.PublicId = person.PublicId;
        p.DisplayName = person.DisplayName;
        p.Upn = person.UserPrincipalName;
        p.Roles = roles.Select(r => new RoleGrant(r.RoleCode, r.ScopeType, r.ScopeId)).Concat(delegations.Select(d => new RoleGrant(Governance.Domain.Roles.DelegatedApprover, ScopeTypes.FundingOwner, d.FundingOwnerId))).ToList();
        p.RoleLabels = roles.Select(r => (r.RoleCode, r.Name, r.ScopeName)).Concat(delegations.Select(d => (Governance.Domain.Roles.DelegatedApprover, "Delegated approver (delegation)", (string?)d.Name))).ToList();
        p.IsCentral = roles.Any(r => r.IsCentral);
        p.Permissions = tenant;
        p.ScopedPermissions = scoped.ToDictionary(kv => kv.Key, kv => (IReadOnlySet<string>)kv.Value);
        p.FundingOwners = roles.Where(r => r.ScopeId is not null).Select(r => (r.ScopeId!.Value, r.ScopeName ?? "")).Concat(delegations).Distinct().ToList();

        // A persona's page roles come from its Workbench roles but never exceed what the signed-in administrator holds.
        p.AppRoles = p.ActingAs
            ? DeriveAppRoles(roles.Select(r => r.RoleCode).ToHashSet()).Where(realAppRoles.Contains).ToHashSet()
            : realAppRoles;
    }

    /// <summary>A test persona's page roles, from its Workbench roles (Development "act as" only).</summary>
    public static HashSet<string> DeriveAppRoles(IReadOnlySet<string> sqlRoles)
    {
        var set = new HashSet<string> { AppRoles.User };
        if (sqlRoles.Any(r => r is Governance.Domain.Roles.PlatformOwner or Governance.Domain.Roles.IntakeAnalyst or Governance.Domain.Roles.PlatformOperator or Governance.Domain.Roles.Architect
                or Governance.Domain.Roles.RiskReviewer or Governance.Domain.Roles.FinOpsLead or Governance.Domain.Roles.FinOpsAnalyst or Governance.Domain.Roles.CommercialApprover
                or Governance.Domain.Roles.SourcingAgent or Governance.Domain.Roles.LicensingOwner or Governance.Domain.Roles.ReportingTeam or Governance.Domain.Roles.Steering))
            set.Add(AppRoles.Central);
        if (sqlRoles.Any(r => r is Governance.Domain.Roles.PlatformOperator or Governance.Domain.Roles.PlatformOwner or Governance.Domain.Roles.IntakeAnalyst)) set.Add(AppRoles.Operator);
        if (sqlRoles.Contains(Governance.Domain.Roles.WorkbenchAdmin)) set.Add(AppRoles.Admin);
        if (sqlRoles.Contains(Governance.Domain.Roles.Auditor)) set.Add(AppRoles.Auditor);
        return set;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// The person by object ID, else by UPN. A UPN row that already belongs to another object ID is someone else (a UPN
    /// given again to a new hire): never theirs. A first visit records the person, once even when two requests race.
    /// </summary>
    internal static async Task<Person?> FindOrCreateAsync(Microsoft.Data.SqlClient.SqlConnection c, Guid? objectId, string? upn, string name, bool create, ILogger log)
    {
        var p = objectId is not null ? await c.QuerySingleOrDefaultAsync<Person>("SELECT * FROM sec.Person WHERE EntraObjectId = @objectId", new { objectId }) : null;
        if (p is null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(upn))
        {
            var byUpn = (await c.QueryAsync<Person>("SELECT * FROM sec.Person WHERE UserPrincipalName = @upn ORDER BY CASE WHEN EntraObjectId IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, PersonId", new { upn })).ToList();
            p = objectId is null ? byUpn.FirstOrDefault() : byUpn.FirstOrDefault(x => x.EntraObjectId is null);
            if (p is null && objectId is not null && byUpn.Count > 0)
                log.LogWarning("{Upn} signed in with object ID {ObjectId}, but the Workbench records that UPN for another object ID: recorded as a new person.", upn, objectId);
            if (p is not null && p.EntraObjectId is null && objectId is not null && create)
                await c.ExecuteAsync("UPDATE sec.Person SET EntraObjectId = @objectId WHERE PersonId = @PersonId AND EntraObjectId IS NULL", new { objectId, p.PersonId });
        }
        if (p is null && create)
        {
            /* One insert even when two first requests race: the check and the insert hold the key range. */
            await c.ExecuteAsync(
                """
                SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL SERIALIZABLE;
                BEGIN TRANSACTION;
                IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sec.Person WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)
                               WHERE (@objectId IS NOT NULL AND EntraObjectId = @objectId) OR (@objectId IS NULL AND UserPrincipalName = @upn))
                    INSERT sec.Person (EntraObjectId, UserPrincipalName, DisplayName, Mail, AccountEnabled) VALUES (@objectId, @upn, @name, @upn, 1);
                COMMIT;
                SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED;
                """, new { objectId, upn, name });
            p = objectId is not null
                ? await c.QuerySingleOrDefaultAsync<Person>("SELECT * FROM sec.Person WHERE EntraObjectId = @objectId", new { objectId })
                : await c.QueryFirstOrDefaultAsync<Person>("SELECT * FROM sec.Person WHERE UserPrincipalName = @upn ORDER BY PersonId", new { upn });
        }
        return p;
    }
}

public sealed class PrincipalMiddleware(RequestDelegate next)
{
    /// <summary>Set on a request refused because the viewer holds the Restricted role: the refusal page says so.</summary>
    public const string RestrictedKey = "workbench-restricted";

    public async Task InvokeAsync(HttpContext http, PrincipalLoader loader, WebPrincipal principal)
    {
        if (http.User.Identity?.IsAuthenticated == true)
        {
            /* In the Workbench's own tenant, whatever tenant the site's pages show (WorkbenchState). */
            var tenants = http.RequestServices.GetRequiredService<CopilotInsights.Infrastructure.TenantAccessor>();
            tenants.Use(http.RequestServices.GetRequiredService<WorkbenchState>().Home(tenants));
            /* A holder of the Restricted role without a Workbench role or Admin: the Workbench is not theirs to see.
               Refused before they are recorded in it, so a refused visit leaves no person behind. */
            var viewer = await http.RequestServices.GetRequiredService<ViewerService>().GetAsync();
            if (viewer.WorkbenchHidden && !IsOpenToAll(http.Request.Path))
            {
                http.Items[RestrictedKey] = true;
                await http.RequestServices.GetRequiredService<CopilotInsights.Infrastructure.AuditLog>().WriteAsync(viewer, "Denied", http.Request.Path, null, "restricted: the Workbench is not among their reports");
                http.Response.StatusCode = StatusCodes.Status403Forbidden;
                return;
            }
            await loader.LoadAsync(http, principal);
            /* Someone the Workbench cannot record (not in the directory yet) reaches only the page that says so. */
            if (!principal.IsAuthenticated && !IsOpenToAll(http.Request.Path))
            {
                http.Response.StatusCode = StatusCodes.Status403Forbidden;
                return;
            }
        }
        await next(http);
    }

    static bool IsOpenToAll(PathString path) =>
        path.StartsWithSegments("/workbench/AccessDenied", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
        || path.StartsWithSegments("/workbench/Error", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
        || path.StartsWithSegments("/workbench/Teams/Launch", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
}

public sealed record AppRoleRequirement(params string[] AnyOf) : IAuthorizationRequirement;

/// <summary>Insights administrators, or the Platform Owner or Steering (RACI, intake switch, central roles, wording).</summary>
public sealed record PlatformGovernanceRequirement : IAuthorizationRequirement;

public sealed class PlatformGovernanceHandler(IHttpContextAccessor http) : AuthorizationHandler<PlatformGovernanceRequirement>
{
    protected override Task HandleRequirementAsync(AuthorizationHandlerContext context, PlatformGovernanceRequirement requirement)
    {
        var p = http.HttpContext?.RequestServices.GetService<WebPrincipal>();
        if (p is { IsAuthenticated: true } && (p.AppRoles.Contains(AppRoles.Admin) || p.HasCentral(Governance.Domain.Roles.PlatformOwner, Governance.Domain.Roles.Steering)))
            context.Succeed(requirement);
        return Task.CompletedTask;
    }
}

/// <summary>Checks the page roles of the acting person (from their Insights grants, or derived for a test persona).</summary>
public sealed class AppRoleHandler(IHttpContextAccessor http) : AuthorizationHandler<AppRoleRequirement>
{
    protected override Task HandleRequirementAsync(AuthorizationHandlerContext context, AppRoleRequirement requirement)
    {
        var p = http.HttpContext?.RequestServices.GetService<WebPrincipal>();
        if (p is { IsAuthenticated: true } && requirement.AnyOf.Any(p.AppRoles.Contains)) context.Succeed(requirement);
        return Task.CompletedTask;
    }
}

    public static string? What(string path) => Text.TryGetValue(path, out var t) ? t : null;

    /// <summary>
    /// The sections for the menu of any page. On an Insights page the Workbench person is not loaded for the request, so
    /// it is loaded here and the sections kept two minutes per person; a Workbench database that does not answer leaves
    /// them out rather than fail the page.
    /// </summary>
    public static async Task<IReadOnlyList<NavGroup>> ForAsync(HttpContext ctx, WebPrincipal me, bool on)
    {
        if (!on || ctx.User.Identity?.IsAuthenticated != true) return [];
        /* A holder of the Restricted role without a Workbench role or Admin sees none of its sections. */
        if ((await ctx.RequestServices.GetRequiredService<CopilotInsights.Infrastructure.ViewerService>().GetAsync()).WorkbenchHidden) return [];
        if (me.IsAuthenticated) return For(me, on);
        /* Only in the Workbench's own tenant: its roles are that tenant's grants. */
        var tenants = ctx.RequestServices.GetRequiredService<CopilotInsights.Infrastructure.TenantAccessor>();
        if (!ctx.RequestServices.GetRequiredService<WorkbenchState>().OnFor(tenants)) return [];
        var cache = ctx.RequestServices.GetRequiredService<Microsoft.Extensions.Caching.Memory.IMemoryCache>();
        /* Per person, tenant and test persona: whatever changes the answer. */
        var key = string.Join("|", "workbench-nav", tenants.Current.Name, ctx.User.Identity?.Name ?? CopilotInsights.Infrastructure.EntraClaims.SignInName(ctx.User),
            ctx.Request.Cookies[PrincipalLoader.ActAsCookie] ?? "");
        if (cache.TryGetValue(key, out IReadOnlyList<NavGroup>? known) && known is not null) return known;
        try
        {
            /* Read only: a visit to an Insights page records no one in the Workbench. */
            await ctx.RequestServices.GetRequiredService<PrincipalLoader>().LoadAsync(ctx, me, create: false);
            /* Someone the Workbench has not met yet: the sections their Insights roles open. */
            var groups = me.IsAuthenticated ? For(me, on) : For(new WebPrincipal
            {
                IsAuthenticated = true,
                AppRoles = PrincipalLoader.PageRoles((await ctx.RequestServices.GetRequiredService<CopilotInsights.Infrastructure.ViewerService>().GetAsync()).Roles),
            }, on);
            cache.Set(key, groups, TimeSpan.FromMinutes(2));
            return groups;
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            /* Not kept: the next page tries again. */
            ctx.RequestServices.GetRequiredService<ILoggerFactory>().CreateLogger(typeof(WorkbenchNav)).LogWarning(ex, "The Workbench menu could not be loaded; the page is shown without it.");
            return [];
        }
    }

    /// <summary>The Workbench sections this person may open: none when the Workbench is off or they could not be loaded.</summary>
    public static IReadOnlyList<NavGroup> For(WebPrincipal? me, bool on)
    {
        if (!on || me is not { IsAuthenticated: true }) return [];
        var central = me.AppRoles.Contains(AppRoles.Central) || me.AppRoles.Contains(AppRoles.Admin);
        var oper = me.AppRoles.Contains(AppRoles.Operator);
        var isAdmin = me.AppRoles.Contains(AppRoles.Admin);
        var settings = isAdmin || me.HasCentral(Roles.PlatformOwner, Roles.Steering);
        var auditor = me.AppRoles.Contains(AppRoles.Auditor) || me.AppRoles.Contains(AppRoles.Central);

        var groups = new List<NavGroup>
        {

                new("Start", $"{P}/Start"), new("My work", $"{P}/MyWork"), new("Requests", $"{P}/Requests"),

                new("Exceptions", $"{P}/Exceptions"), new("Retirement", $"{P}/Retirement"), new("Your Workbench roles", $"{P}/Me")]),
        };
        if (central)
            groups.Add(new("Approval queues", "Intake, specialists and decision makers", [
                new("Intake", $"{P}/Queues/Intake"), new("Classification", $"{P}/Queues/Classification"), new("Specialist reviews", $"{P}/Queues/Reviews"),

        var registry = new List<NavPage> { new("Funding owners", $"{P}/Registry/FundingOwners"), new("Workloads", $"{P}/Registry/Workloads"), new("Envelopes", $"{P}/Registry/Envelopes") };
        if (Governance.Web.Pages.Registry.SeatsModel.CanOpen(me)) registry.Add(new("Copilot seats", $"{P}/Registry/Seats"));
        registry.Add(new("Services", $"{P}/Registry/Services"));
        registry.Add(new("Control templates", $"{P}/Registry/Templates"));

            registry.Add(new("Commercial", $"{P}/Registry/Commercial"));

        groups.Add(new("Ownership registry", "Funding owners, workloads, seats and the service catalog", registry));

// Tooltips for chart marks (data-tip), the crosshair on line charts,
// the theme toggle, and the filter controls. No inline script: the CSP forbids it.
(function () {
  var tip = document.getElementById('tip');

  function show(e, text) {
    tip.textContent = text;
    tip.hidden = false;
    var x = e.clientX + 14, y = e.clientY + 14;
    var r = tip.getBoundingClientRect();
    if (x + r.width > window.innerWidth - 8) x = e.clientX - r.width - 14;
    if (y + r.height > window.innerHeight - 8) y = e.clientY - r.height - 14;
    tip.style.left = x + 'px';
    tip.style.top = y + 'px';
  }

  document.addEventListener('mousemove', function (e) {
    var t = e.target.closest ? e.target.closest('[data-tip]') : null;
    var svg = e.target.closest ? e.target.closest('svg.chart') : null;
    if (svg) {
      var cross = svg.querySelector('.cross');
      if (cross) {
        if (t && t.hasAttribute('data-x')) {
          cross.setAttribute('x1', t.getAttribute('data-x'));
          cross.setAttribute('x2', t.getAttribute('data-x'));
          cross.style.visibility = 'visible';
        } else { cross.style.visibility = 'hidden'; }
      }
    }
    // An information icon's text sits under the icon, not under the pointer.
    if (t && t.classList.contains('infob')) { if (tip.hidden || tip.textContent !== t.getAttribute('data-tip')) showAt(t); }
    else if (t) show(e, t.getAttribute('data-tip'));
    else if (!(e.target.closest && e.target.closest('nav.side [data-what]'))) tip.hidden = true;   // the navigation shows its own
  });
  document.addEventListener('mouseleave', function () { tip.hidden = true; });

  // Information icons: the same tip on keyboard focus or a tap, under the icon and inside the window.
  function showAt(b) {
    tip.textContent = b.getAttribute('data-tip');
    tip.hidden = false;
    var r = b.getBoundingClientRect(), t = tip.getBoundingClientRect();
    var x = Math.max(8, Math.min(r.left, window.innerWidth - t.width - 8));
    var y = r.bottom + 6;
    if (y + t.height > window.innerHeight - 8) y = Math.max(8, r.top - t.height - 6);
    tip.style.left = x + 'px';
    tip.style.top = y + 'px';
  }
  document.querySelectorAll('button.infob').forEach(function (b) {
    b.addEventListener('focus', function () { showAt(b); });
    b.addEventListener('blur', function () { tip.hidden = true; });
    b.addEventListener('click', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); if (tip.hidden) showAt(b); else tip.hidden = true; });
    b.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) { if (e.key === 'Escape') tip.hidden = true; });
  });

  var toggle = document.getElementById('theme-toggle');
  if (toggle) toggle.addEventListener('click', function () {
    var root = document.documentElement;
    var dark = root.getAttribute('data-theme') === 'dark' ||
      (!root.getAttribute('data-theme') && window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches);
    var next = dark ? 'light' : 'dark';
    root.setAttribute('data-theme', next);
    try { localStorage.setItem('insights-theme', next); } catch (e) { }
  });

  document.querySelectorAll('select[data-autosubmit]').forEach(function (s) {
    s.addEventListener('change', function () { s.form.submit(); });
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('select[data-navigate]').forEach(function (s) {
    s.addEventListener('change', function () { if (s.value) location.href = s.value; });
  });
  // A box that takes a person (PersonBox): nothing is asked until three letters are typed, then, a quarter of a second
  // after the typing stops, the names whose first or last name begins with them are offered. Choosing one fills in the
  // sign-in. A sign-in typed in full needs no search.
  document.querySelectorAll('input[data-lookup]').forEach(function (box) {
    var list = document.getElementById(box.getAttribute('list'));
    var min = parseInt(box.getAttribute('data-min'), 10) || 3;
    var timer = null, asked = '';
    if (!list) return;
    function offer(rows) {
      while (list.firstChild) list.removeChild(list.firstChild);
      rows.forEach(function (r) {
        var o = document.createElement('option');
        o.value = r.value; o.label = r.label; o.textContent = r.label;
        list.appendChild(o);
      });
    }
    box.addEventListener('input', function () {
      var q = box.value.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
      window.clearTimeout(timer);
      if (q.replace(/[^0-9A-Za-z\u00C0-\uFFFF]/g, '').length < min) { asked = ''; offer([]); return; }
      // Choosing a name puts its sign-in in the box: that is an answer, not a search.
      for (var i = 0; i < list.options.length; i++) if (list.options[i].value === box.value) return;
      if (q === asked) return;
      timer = window.setTimeout(function () {
        asked = q;
        fetch(box.getAttribute('data-lookup') + '&q=' + encodeURIComponent(q), { credentials: 'same-origin', headers: { 'Accept': 'application/json' } })
          .then(function (r) { return r.ok ? r.json() : []; })
          .then(function (rows) { if (asked === q) offer(rows); })
          .catch(function () { });
      }, 250);
    });
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-print]').forEach(function (b) {
    b.addEventListener('click', function () { window.print(); });
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('form[data-confirm]').forEach(function (f) {
    f.addEventListener('submit', function (e) { if (!window.confirm(f.getAttribute('data-confirm'))) e.preventDefault(); });
  });
  // Column headers sort a table in the page: by each cell's data-v when it has one (numbers,
  // dates), else by a number at the start of its text ("45%", "$1,200"), else by its text. Numbers and
  // dates open largest or latest first, text A to Z; a second click reverses. Rows marked data-keep stay last.
  function key(td) {
    if (!td) return { n: null, t: '' };
    var v = td.getAttribute('data-v');
    if (v !== null && v !== '') return { n: parseFloat(v), t: v };
    var t = td.textContent.trim();
    // A leading arrow carries the sign of a change ("▼ 12%" is -12); so does a minus, plain or typographic.
    var m = /^([\u25B2\u25BC\u2191\u2193]?)\s*([-+\u2212]?)\s*[$\u20AC\u00A3]?\s?(\d[\d,]*(\.\d+)?)/.exec(t);
    var n = m ? parseFloat(m[3].replace(/,/g, '')) : null;
    if (m && (m[1] === '\u25BC' || m[1] === '\u2193' || m[2] === '-' || m[2] === '\u2212')) n = -n;
    return { n: n, t: t.toLowerCase() };
  }
  document.querySelectorAll('table.sortable').forEach(function (table) {
    var heads = table.tHead.rows[0].cells;
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(heads, function (th, col) {
      var b = th.querySelector('button.sort');
      if (!b) return;
      b.addEventListener('click', function () {
        var body = table.tBodies[0];
        var rows = Array.prototype.slice.call(body.rows);
        var keep = rows.filter(function (r) { return r.hasAttribute('data-keep'); });
        rows = rows.filter(function (r) { return !r.hasAttribute('data-keep'); });
        var keys = rows.map(function (r) { return key(r.cells[col]); });
        var filled = keys.filter(function (k) { return k.t !== '' && k.t !== '—'; });
        var numeric = filled.length > 0 && filled.every(function (k) { return k.n !== null && !isNaN(k.n); });
        var was = th.getAttribute('aria-sort');
        var desc = was ? was === 'ascending' : numeric;
        var order = rows.map(function (r, i) { return { r: r, k: keys[i], i: i }; });
        order.sort(function (a, b) {
          var x, y, c;
          if (numeric) {
            x = isNaN(a.k.n) || a.k.n === null ? -Infinity : a.k.n;
            y = isNaN(b.k.n) || b.k.n === null ? -Infinity : b.k.n;
            c = x < y ? -1 : x > y ? 1 : 0;
          } else c = a.k.t.localeCompare(b.k.t, undefined, { numeric: true, sensitivity: 'base' });
          return (desc ? -c : c) || a.i - b.i;
        });
        order.forEach(function (o) { body.appendChild(o.r); });
        keep.forEach(function (r) { body.appendChild(r); });
        Array.prototype.forEach.call(heads, function (h) { h.removeAttribute('aria-sort'); });
        th.setAttribute('aria-sort', desc ? 'descending' : 'ascending');
        if (table.showPage) table.showPage(1);
      });
    });
  });

  // The start page's areas: a card opens its reports in a window, closed by Escape, its × or a click outside.
  // Without script, or a browser without <dialog>, the card is a link to the area's first report.
  document.querySelectorAll('a[data-dialog]').forEach(function (a) {
    var d = document.getElementById(a.getAttribute('data-dialog'));
    if (!d || typeof d.showModal !== 'function') return;
    a.addEventListener('click', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); d.showModal(); var l = d.querySelector('ul a'); if (l) l.focus(); });
    var x = d.querySelector('.pclose');
    if (x) x.addEventListener('click', function () { d.close(); });
    d.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
      var r = d.getBoundingClientRect();
      if (e.clientX < r.left || e.clientX > r.right || e.clientY < r.top || e.clientY > r.bottom) d.close();
    });
    d.addEventListener('close', function () { a.focus(); });
  });

  // A table of more than a page of rows shows one page at a time, 50 rows as the server's lists do. Rows marked
  // data-keep (a total) stay on every page. Hidden rows are only off the screen: printing shows every row.
  document.querySelectorAll('table[data-page-size]').forEach(function (table) {
    var size = parseInt(table.getAttribute('data-page-size'), 10) || 50;
    var bar = document.createElement('nav');   // the same element, place and look as a list paged on the server
    bar.className = 'tpager';
    bar.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Pages');
    var wrap = table.closest('.table-wrap') || table;
    wrap.parentNode.insertBefore(bar, wrap.nextSibling);
    function link(text, page, on) {
      var a = document.createElement('button');
      a.type = 'button';
      a.className = on ? 'on' : '';
      a.textContent = text;
      if (on) a.setAttribute('aria-current', 'page');
      a.addEventListener('click', function () { table.showPage(page); wrap.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest' }); });
      return a;
    }
    table.showPage = function (page) {
      var rows = Array.prototype.filter.call(table.tBodies[0].rows, function (r) { return !r.hasAttribute('data-keep'); });
      var pages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(rows.length / size));
      page = Math.min(Math.max(1, page), pages);
      rows.forEach(function (r, i) { r.classList.toggle('pg-off', i < (page - 1) * size || i >= page * size); });
      bar.textContent = '';
      var info = document.createElement('span');
      info.className = 'muted';
      info.textContent = ((page - 1) * size + 1).toLocaleString() + '–' + Math.min(page * size, rows.length).toLocaleString() + ' of ' + rows.length.toLocaleString();
      bar.appendChild(info);
      if (page > 1) bar.appendChild(link('‹ Previous', page - 1, false));
      // The first, the last, and the pages around this one.
      var shown = 0;
      for (var p = 1; p <= pages; p++) {
        if (p === 1 || p === pages || Math.abs(p - page) <= 2) { bar.appendChild(link(String(p), p, p === page)); shown = p; }
        else if (shown === p - 1) { var gap = document.createElement('span'); gap.className = 'muted'; gap.textContent = '…'; bar.appendChild(gap); }
      }
      if (page < pages) bar.appendChild(link('Next ›', page + 1, false));
    };
    table.showPage(1);
  });

  // Admin › Reports shown: a section's own box ticks or clears every report in it, and follows them.
  document.querySelectorAll('.card.pick').forEach(function (card) {
    var all = card.querySelector('input[data-all]');
    var boxes = card.querySelectorAll('input[name="show"]');
    if (!all) return;
    all.addEventListener('change', function () { Array.prototype.forEach.call(boxes, function (b) { b.checked = all.checked; }); });
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(boxes, function (b) {
      b.addEventListener('change', function () { all.checked = Array.prototype.every.call(boxes, function (x) { return x.checked; }); });
    });
  });

  // ---- The navigation ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  var nav = document.querySelector('nav.side');
  if (nav) (function () {
    var grps = Array.prototype.slice.call(nav.querySelectorAll('.grp'));
    function fold(g, open) {
      g.classList.toggle('open', open);
      g.querySelector('.gname').setAttribute('aria-expanded', open ? 'true' : 'false');
    }
    // A narrow window: one button shows or hides the sections.
    var tog = nav.querySelector('.navtog');
    if (tog) tog.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
      e.stopPropagation();
      var on = !nav.classList.contains('shown');
      nav.classList.toggle('shown', on);
      tog.setAttribute('aria-expanded', on ? 'true' : 'false');
    });

    // A click on a section opens it, or folds it if it is open, and changes nothing else: the row clicked stays where
    // it is, under the pointer (folding the section above it would move it away). Every page starts with the section
    // it belongs to open and the rest folded, a page come back to with Back too; nothing is remembered between pages.
    // Where the list scrolls on its own, folding a section near its end would pull the rows down (there is less to
    // scroll): the list's scroll is put back so the row clicked stays put, with room left under the last section if needed.
    var room = document.createElement('div');
    room.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
    nav.appendChild(room);
    function steady(row, was) {
      if (getComputedStyle(nav).overflowY !== 'auto') return;   // a narrow window: the list is part of the page, and nothing above the row changes
      var left = row.getBoundingClientRect().top - was;
      if (Math.abs(left) > 0.5) {
        nav.scrollTop += left;
        left = row.getBoundingClientRect().top - was;
        if (left > 0.5) {   // nothing left to scroll: make room under the last section, then scroll
          room.style.height = (room.offsetHeight + left + nav.clientHeight) + 'px';
          nav.scrollTop += left;
        }
      }
      // No more room than the scroll position needs.
      var need = nav.scrollTop + nav.clientHeight - (nav.scrollHeight - room.offsetHeight);
      room.style.height = Math.max(0, Math.ceil(need)) + 'px';
    }
    grps.forEach(function (g) {
      var b = g.querySelector('.gname');
      b.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        e.stopPropagation();
        close(false);
        var was = b.getBoundingClientRect().top;
        fold(g, !g.classList.contains('open'));
        steady(b, was);
      });
    });
    window.addEventListener('pageshow', function (e) {
      if (!e.persisted) return;
      close(false);
      // The start page shows the most used as shortcuts, so that section stays folded there too.
      grps.forEach(function (g) { fold(g, g.classList.contains('here')); });
      var f = document.getElementById('nav-find');
      if (f && f.value) { f.value = ''; f.dispatchEvent(new Event('input')); }
    });

    // "About these reports" opens the section's panel. Escape, its close button or a click elsewhere closes it.
    var shown = null, at = [0, 0];
    // A scroll closes the panel: a real one, not the last event of a scroll that ended before it opened.
    function scrolled() { if (shown && (Math.abs(window.scrollY - at[0]) > 2 || Math.abs(nav.scrollTop - at[1]) > 2)) close(false); }
    function close(focus) {
      if (!shown) return;
      var b = shown.querySelector('.gabout');
      shown.querySelector('.gpanel').hidden = true;
      b.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
      shown = null;
      if (focus) b.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    }
    grps.forEach(function (g) {
      var b = g.querySelector('.gabout'), panel = g.querySelector('.gpanel');
      if (!b || !panel) return;   // Your most used has no panel: its reports are described in their own sections
      b.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        e.stopPropagation();
        var mine = shown === g;
        close(false);
        if (mine) return;
        tip.hidden = true;
        at = [window.scrollY, nav.scrollTop];
        panel.hidden = false;
        // Beside the section it belongs to, level with its name, and wholly inside the window.
        if (window.innerWidth > 900) {
          var top = g.getBoundingClientRect().top, h = panel.getBoundingClientRect().height;
          panel.style.top = Math.max(58, Math.min(top, window.innerHeight - h - 8)) + 'px';
        } else panel.style.top = '';
        b.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
        shown = g;
        var first = panel.querySelector('a.on') || panel.querySelector('a');
        if (first) first.focus({ preventScroll: true });
      });
      panel.addEventListener('click', function (e) { e.stopPropagation(); });
      panel.querySelector('.pclose').addEventListener('click', function () { close(true); });
    });
    document.addEventListener('click', function () { close(false); });
    window.addEventListener('scroll', scrolled, { passive: true });
    nav.addEventListener('scroll', function () { scrolled(); tip.hidden = true; }, { passive: true });
    window.addEventListener('resize', function () { close(false); });
    document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) { if (e.key === 'Escape' && shown) close(true); });

    // Find a report: by its name, by what it answers, or by its section ("licensing", "finance"). Enter opens the first
    // that matches; the arrow keys walk the matches; "/" from anywhere on the page puts the cursor in the box.
    var find = document.getElementById('nav-find'), none = document.getElementById('nav-none'), count = document.getElementById('nav-count');
    if (find) {
      var links = Array.prototype.slice.call(nav.querySelectorAll('.glinks a'));
      function matches() { return links.filter(function (x) { return !x.hidden && x.offsetParent !== null; }); }
      function apply() {
        var q = find.value.trim().toLowerCase();
        close(false);
        nav.classList.toggle('finding', q !== '');
        // A report matches by its name or by what it answers; a section's own name brings all its reports; and when
        // nothing matches at all, a section's audience does ("finops" for Licensing), so the box is forgiving but exact first.
        function pass(audience) {
          var n = 0;
          grps.forEach(function (g) {
            var mine = g.classList.contains('mine');
            var words = (g.getAttribute('data-grp') || '') + (audience ? ' ' + (g.getAttribute('data-who') || '') : '');
            var whole = q !== '' && !mine && words.toLowerCase().indexOf(q) >= 0;
            var hit = 0;
            Array.prototype.forEach.call(g.querySelectorAll('.glinks a'), function (a) {
              var m = q === '' || whole || (a.textContent + ' ' + (a.getAttribute('data-what') || '')).toLowerCase().indexOf(q) >= 0;
              a.hidden = !m;
              if (m) hit++;
            });
            g.hidden = q !== '' && (hit === 0 || mine);
            if (!mine) n += hit;
          });
          return n;
        }
        var n = pass(false);
        if (n === 0 && q !== '') n = pass(true);
        if (none) none.hidden = q === '' || n > 0;
        if (count) { count.hidden = q === '' || n === 0; count.textContent = n === 1 ? '1 report' : n + ' reports'; }
      }
      find.addEventListener('input', apply);
      find.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
        var m = matches();
        if (e.key === 'Enter') { if (m[0] && find.value.trim() !== '') location.href = m[0].href; }
        else if (e.key === 'Escape') { find.value = ''; apply(); }
        else if (e.key === 'ArrowDown' && m[0]) { e.preventDefault(); m[0].focus(); }
      });
      // Down and up move through the links showing, in the list or among the matches; up from the first goes back to the box.
      nav.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
        if ((e.key !== 'ArrowDown' && e.key !== 'ArrowUp') || e.target === find) return;
        var m = matches(), i = m.indexOf(document.activeElement);
        if (i < 0) return;
        e.preventDefault();
        if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') { if (m[i + 1]) m[i + 1].focus(); }
        else if (i === 0) find.focus(); else m[i - 1].focus();
      });
      document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
        if (e.key !== '/' || e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey || e.altKey) return;
        var t = e.target, tag = t && t.tagName;
        if (tag === 'INPUT' || tag === 'TEXTAREA' || tag === 'SELECT' || (t && t.isContentEditable)) return;
        e.preventDefault();
        find.focus();
        find.select();
      });
    }

    // What a report answers, beside its link: after a moment under the pointer, at once on keyboard focus.
    // To the right of the list, so it covers no other link; the pointer keeps its own shape.
    var wait = null;
    function what(el) {
      var text = el.getAttribute('data-what');
      if (!text || shown) return;
      tip.textContent = text;
      tip.hidden = false;
      var r = el.getBoundingClientRect(), n = nav.getBoundingClientRect(), t = tip.getBoundingClientRect();
      var x = n.right + 8, y = r.top;
      if (x + t.width > window.innerWidth - 8) { x = Math.max(8, r.left); y = r.bottom + 6; }   // a narrow window: under the link
      if (y + t.height > window.innerHeight - 8) y = Math.max(8, window.innerHeight - t.height - 8);
      tip.style.left = x + 'px';
      tip.style.top = y + 'px';
    }
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(nav.querySelectorAll('.glinks [data-what]'), function (el) {
      el.addEventListener('mouseenter', function () { clearTimeout(wait); wait = setTimeout(function () { what(el); }, 450); });
      el.addEventListener('mouseleave', function () { clearTimeout(wait); tip.hidden = true; });
      el.addEventListener('focus', function () { clearTimeout(wait); what(el); });
      el.addEventListener('blur', function () { clearTimeout(wait); tip.hidden = true; });
    });
  })();

  // The admin forms put the question on the button.
  /* A box that ticks or clears every box of one form (Admin › Access: the people and groups on the page). */
  document.querySelectorAll('input[data-check-all]').forEach(function (all) {
    all.addEventListener('change', function () {
      document.querySelectorAll('input[type="checkbox"][form="' + all.getAttribute('data-check-all') + '"]').forEach(function (b) { b.checked = all.checked; });
    });
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('button[data-confirm]').forEach(function (b) {
    b.addEventListener('click', function (e) { if (!window.confirm(b.getAttribute('data-confirm'))) e.preventDefault(); });
  });

  /* "Change it" beside an assumption opens its page at the field: ?focus=Name, or ?focus=name|key for a field of a
     row (a price), whose form holds the key in a hidden field. The field is scrolled to, focused and marked a moment. */
  (function () {
    var want = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get('focus');
    if (!want) return;
    var parts = want.split('|'), name = parts[0], key = parts.length > 1 ? parts.slice(1).join('|') : null, field = null;
    var esc = window.CSS && CSS.escape ? CSS.escape : function (s) { return s.replace(/["\\]/g, '\\$&'); };
    if (key !== null) {
      var hidden = Array.prototype.find.call(document.querySelectorAll('form input[type="hidden"]'), function (h) { return h.value === key; });
      if (hidden) field = hidden.form.querySelector('[name="' + esc(name) + '"]');
    } else field = document.querySelector('form [name="' + esc(name) + '"]:not([type="hidden"])');
    if (!field) return;
    var mark = field.closest('label') || field;
    mark.classList.add('focus-mark');
    field.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' });
    field.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    setTimeout(function () { mark.classList.remove('focus-mark'); }, 4000);
  })();
})();

# Copilot Insights dashboard

A web dashboard over the Copilot audit data. Everyone signs in with their Windows account, or through Microsoft Entra ID where the site is set up for it ([ENTRA-SIGN-IN.md](ENTRA-SIGN-IN.md), 2.8.0), and sees the part of the organization they are entitled to. Executives and anyone granted it see everything; a manager sees their own people; everyone else sees their own use. Pages are grouped by persona. A web-based admin module holds every setting: access, email, alerts, digests and the webhook, targets and assumptions, privacy and retention, reference data and value names, classifications and events, scheduled extracts, training records, directory quality, health and the audit log. One dashboard can span several Microsoft 365 tenants.

It is an ASP.NET Core 10 (Razor Pages) site hosted in IIS on Windows Server 2022 or later. It reads the Copilot database the pipeline already fills: the `bi` star schema, plus its own `dash` schema of settings, roles, the org chart and daily rollups. It has no other data store.

**Read-only towards Microsoft 365, unless someone approves a change.** Nothing in the dashboard or the pipeline changes anything in Microsoft 365, Entra or Azure: license changes are files and scripts an administrator reviews and runs with their own rights. What it does write, and where:

| It writes | Where | Set by |
|---|---|---|
| Its settings, roles, names, rules and logs | Its own `dash` tables | Administrators, in the Admin pages |
| Email | Exchange Online or the SMTP server set in Admin › Email | Alerts and digests |
| Alert posts | The one webhook address set in Admin › Alerts and digests | Alerts |
| CSV files of aggregates | The folders set in Admin › Scheduled extracts | Scheduled extracts |
| License files and scripts | The administrator's browser, as downloads | License exports |

The roadmap's later milestones (M13 to M15) would add changes in Microsoft 365 itself, such as deploying an approved DLP policy. They would use a separate app registration whose credentials the pipeline does not hold, and act only on a change a second person has approved.

**Status.** Released in 2.2.0; the operations features (alerts, digests, the admin settings, value names, the data API, triage, planning, classifications, extracts, multi-tenancy and the pages listed below) in 2.3.0. Every page, the security model, the admin changes and the rollups were tested against a synthetic 2,317-person demo database, a 40-million-interaction scale database and the SQL integration suite; email was tested against a local SMTP server requiring authentication, on ports 2525 (STARTTLS) and 4465 (implicit TLS); every page's layout was checked in a browser at 1440 and 1024 pixels wide for clipped, overlapping or shortened labels. It has not yet run on a Windows Server under IIS. See [Not yet proven](#not-yet-proven).

## What each persona gets

**Finding a report (2.4.9).** The list on the left shows the sections, folded, with the one you are in open and your page marked. Selecting a section opens its reports under it, and selecting it again folds them; nothing else in the list moves, and each page starts with only its own section open. The list stays on screen while a long report scrolls. *About these reports*, under an open section's reports, opens a panel beside it with all of them under their headings (in Licensing: inventory and pool, cost savings, policy breaches, changes ahead), each with a sentence on what it answers and the role it needs; Escape, the close button or a click elsewhere closes it. **Your most used**, the first section, lists up to ten reports you opened most in the last 90 days, once you have opened three: it is counted from the audit log of page views the dashboard already keeps, worked out once a day, and nothing is saved or set up for it. *Find a report* at the top narrows the list as you type, by a report's name, by what it answers, or by its section's name or audience; it says how many match, the arrow keys walk them and Enter opens the first; pressing / on any page puts the cursor there. Resting the pointer on a report's link, or reaching it with the keyboard, shows the same sentence beside the list. The start page is the full index: every report you may open, under the same headings, with the same sentences. The foot of each report offers the report before it in its section and the one after (2.4.10), each with its sentence, and keeps the period and the part of the organization you are looking at. Reports you may not open, and reports an administrator has turned off, are in none of them. An address with no page behind it (mistyped, or a bookmark to a page since moved) is answered with *Page not found* (2.4.10): the address, the reports nearest to it among those you can open, and the way to the start page.

**Seven sections belong to a role (2.4.2):** Adoption (the **Adoption** role), Licensing and Forecasting (**Licensing**), Security (**Security**), Compliance (**Compliance**), Agents (**Agents**) and Enablement (**Enablement**). Without the role, the whole section is hidden from the navigation and the start page, its aggregate pages included, and its pages and API calls are refused; this holds for the top of the organization too. Leadership, Regions, People, App owners and Governance are open to everyone who may use the dashboard, for their own part of the organization, except to holders of the **Restricted** role, who see only Start, Leadership and the sections their other roles open (with Agents: Start, Leadership and Agents), and, where they see the whole organization, may choose *See all reports* ([OPERATIONS.md](OPERATIONS.md#access-and-permissions)). Who may use it at all can be limited to the top levels of the organization ([Who sees what](#who-sees-what)).

Pages without a role mark show aggregates only: counts, rates and trends for the viewer's scope, broken down one level at a time. Pages marked with a role list named people. They need that role, and even then they show only people inside the viewer's own scope. The navigation and the start page list only the pages the viewer can open: someone without a role never sees its section, an administrator's Admin pages are invisible to everyone else, and a persona with nothing open to the viewer is left out.

| Persona | Page | What it answers | Grain | Named people |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Leadership | Overview | People using Copilot, licensed, adoption, active in the last 7 days; trends; adoption by the next level down | Scope, then one level down | No |
| | What to act on | What the other reports say to do, as one list of counts: license holders with no licensed use in the last 30 days, license holders to train, free Copilot Chat users ready for a license, licenses on non-human accounts, parts of the organization more than 10 points under the adoption around them, targets behind or missed, and, for the Security role, jailbreak attempts and prompt injections. Each with why it matters and a link to the report with the detail, or that report's name and the role it needs | Scope | No |
| | Organization | How many units, and the highest and lowest adoption among those large enough to rank (2.7.4), each opening that unit (2.7.5); each unit one level down side by side: people, licensed, active, adoption, days active, interactions, share of sessions with a follow-up, a trend line; heatmap of share active per week | One level down | No |
| | Compare two teams | Two managers' teams side by side, each manager with everyone under them: people, license holders, adoption, share using Copilot, interactions and days active per person, prompts per session, sessions with a follow-up, the difference between the two, both trends, and each app's share of each team's use. A team outside the viewer's part, under the minimum group size, or any team in privacy mode is not shown | Two teams | No (the two managers are named) |
| | Apps and agents | Interactions, with the Copilot Chat and agent shares as figures (2.7.3); interactions by app over time, Copilot Chat and agent share, most-used agents | Scope | No |

| | Costs and savings | All AI and automation spend on one page (2.6.6): Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio credits, Fabric with Copilot in Power BI, Power BI, Power Automate, Power Apps with Dataverse, GitHub Copilot and Foundry; each area's spend a month, the savings in it and the value it returns; the savings ranked by what they are worth, with what to do and how sure; the last six months' spend; Copilot in Power BI's share of the capacity, cost and return; what holds the return back | Tenant | No |
| | Copilot reservations | Each line of business's reserved Microsoft 365 Copilot seats against the add-on licenses its people hold (2.6.8): reserved, allocated, unused, over, billable, utilization and the monthly and remaining obligation by organization, the reconciliation with the license pool, the purchase gate, exceptions, month-end snapshots, and the register, rate and Technology-funded pool for administrators. Current operational state, never certified | Scope, organization | No |

An L2 manager, who reports directly to the CEO, sees the whole organization. The Leadership pages are theirs, and so are the Regions, People, App owners and Governance pages. Whole-organization access doesn't include a role's section or its named lists: those need the role.

The pages whose scope is *Tenant* (License pool, Budget and renewal) are the tenant's in every figure, for a viewer with the Licensing role and their own part of the organization too (2.4.12): they set that viewer's own part's use against the tenant's seats, which made a renewal figure that was neither. The Board pack shows the tenant's seats bought and assigned only to the viewers License pool shows them to, the whole-organization view and the Licensing role, and says they are the whole tenant's when it is printed for a part of the organization.

## Governance Workbench pages

From 3.0.0 the dashboard also serves the Governance Workbench: requests and approvals for Copilot workloads, routed by a RACI matrix, and the registry of who owns and funds them. Its pages are under `/workbench/...` and its sections come after the dashboard's in the navigation. They exist only when the site's settings name the Workbench's database (`ConnectionStrings:Governance`); otherwise every `/workbench` address is *Page not found* and the dashboard is as before. [OPERATIONS.md](OPERATIONS.md#governance-workbench) covers turning it on and the roles; [GOVERNANCE-USER-GUIDE.md](GOVERNANCE-USER-GUIDE.md) says where each person starts.

Which sections a person sees comes from their grants in Admin › Access: **Governance**, **GovernanceOperator**, **GovernanceAuditor** and **Admin**. What they may do on a page (approve, record a decision, see one line of business's seats) comes from their roles inside the Workbench. These grants open no usage data. A page someone may not open says *This page is not available to you* and who grants it.
