/* Roles granted to people (by UPN) or AD groups (DOMAIN\Group). */
IF OBJECT_ID(N'dash.RoleGrant', N'U') IS NULL
    CREATE TABLE dash.RoleGrant
    (
        GrantId       INT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT PK_DashRoleGrant PRIMARY KEY,
        Principal     NVARCHAR(256)   NOT NULL,   -- a UPN, or DOMAIN\Group
        PrincipalType VARCHAR(8)      NOT NULL CONSTRAINT CK_DashRoleGrant_Type CHECK (PrincipalType IN ('User', 'Group')),
        Role          VARCHAR(32)     NOT NULL CONSTRAINT CK_DashRoleGrant_Role CHECK (Role IN
                          ('Admin', 'Organization', 'Adoption', 'Licensing', 'Security', 'Compliance', 'Agents', 'Enablement', 'Governance', 'GovernanceOperator', 'GovernanceAuditor', 'Restricted')),
        Note          NVARCHAR(400)   NULL,
        GrantedBy     NVARCHAR(256)   NOT NULL,
        GrantedUtc    DATETIME2(0)    NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_DashRoleGrant_Granted DEFAULT (SYSUTCDATETIME()),
        CONSTRAINT UQ_DashRoleGrant UNIQUE (Principal, Role)
    );

/* An Admin grant can be limited to some of the Admin pages: their paths, comma-separated
   (/admin/health,/admin/audit). NULL, as on every grant before, is the whole role. Other roles leave it NULL. */
IF COL_LENGTH(N'dash.RoleGrant', N'Pages') IS NULL ALTER TABLE dash.RoleGrant ADD Pages NVARCHAR(1000) NULL;
/* The 2.6.4 build that was withdrawn kept such pages under a role of its own, Persona. Where a database has any, they
   become Admin grants limited to the same pages (an Admin grant the same person already holds wins), and the role's
   check goes back to the eight roles. */
IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.check_constraints WHERE name = N'CK_DashRoleGrant_Role' AND parent_object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'dash.RoleGrant') AND definition LIKE N'%Persona%')
BEGIN
    EXEC (N'DELETE p FROM dash.RoleGrant AS p
            WHERE p.Role = ''Persona'' AND (NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(p.Pages)), N'''') IS NULL
                  OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dash.RoleGrant AS a WHERE a.Principal = p.Principal AND a.Role = ''Admin''));');
    ALTER TABLE dash.RoleGrant DROP CONSTRAINT CK_DashRoleGrant_Role;
    UPDATE dash.RoleGrant SET Role = 'Admin' WHERE Role = 'Persona';
    ALTER TABLE dash.RoleGrant ADD CONSTRAINT CK_DashRoleGrant_Role CHECK (Role IN
        ('Admin', 'Organization', 'Adoption', 'Licensing', 'Security', 'Compliance', 'Agents', 'Enablement', 'Governance', 'GovernanceOperator', 'GovernanceAuditor', 'Restricted'));
END;

/* The Governance Workbench's three page roles (Governance, GovernanceOperator, GovernanceAuditor) join the eight, and
   Restricted, the role that narrows what its holder sees, joins them: a database whose check lacks any of them has it
   widened. Nothing already granted changes. */
IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.check_constraints WHERE name = N'CK_DashRoleGrant_Role' AND parent_object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'dash.RoleGrant') AND definition NOT LIKE N'%Restricted%')
BEGIN
    ALTER TABLE dash.RoleGrant DROP CONSTRAINT CK_DashRoleGrant_Role;
    ALTER TABLE dash.RoleGrant ADD CONSTRAINT CK_DashRoleGrant_Role CHECK (Role IN
        ('Admin', 'Organization', 'Adoption', 'Licensing', 'Security', 'Compliance', 'Agents', 'Enablement', 'Governance', 'GovernanceOperator', 'GovernanceAuditor', 'Restricted'));
END;

/* With sign-in through Entra ID, a grant to an Entra group names it as entra:<object ID>, with the ID kept in a column
   of its own and the group's name as it was when granted, for the lists. NULL on every grant to a UPN or to DOMAIN\name. */
IF COL_LENGTH(N'dash.RoleGrant', N'PrincipalObjectId') IS NULL ALTER TABLE dash.RoleGrant ADD PrincipalObjectId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL;
IF COL_LENGTH(N'dash.RoleGrant', N'PrincipalName') IS NULL ALTER TABLE dash.RoleGrant ADD PrincipalName NVARCHAR(256) NULL;
/* Across the whole organization: a persona role (Adoption, Licensing, Security, Compliance, Agents, Enablement) held
   with it shows that role's pages for the whole organization, where without it they show the holder's own part. It
   widens nothing else: other sections, the minimum group size and privacy mode apply as before. 0 on every grant before. */
IF COL_LENGTH(N'dash.RoleGrant', N'OrgWide') IS NULL
    ALTER TABLE dash.RoleGrant ADD OrgWide BIT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_DashRoleGrant_OrgWide DEFAULT (0);

/* Access profiles: a named bundle of roles (each with or without the whole organization) and Admin pages, granted
   to people and groups as one. Changing a profile changes it for everyone who holds it. Grants role by role keep working. */
IF OBJECT_ID(N'dash.AccessProfile', N'U') IS NULL
    CREATE TABLE dash.AccessProfile
    (
        ProfileId         INT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT PK_DashAccessProfile PRIMARY KEY,
        Name              NVARCHAR(100)   NOT NULL CONSTRAINT UQ_DashAccessProfile_Name UNIQUE,
        Description       NVARCHAR(400)   NULL,
        OwnerUpn          NVARCHAR(256)   NULL,       -- who answers for it
        ApproverPrincipal NVARCHAR(256)   NULL,       -- who approves a request for it, as told to the person asking
        MaxDays           INT             NULL,       -- how long access lasts, as the access package that grants it says
        RequestUrl        NVARCHAR(1000)  NULL,       -- where to ask for it: a My Access link to its access package
        UpdatedBy         NVARCHAR(256)   NOT NULL,
        UpdatedUtc        DATETIME2(0)    NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_DashAccessProfile_Updated DEFAULT (SYSUTCDATETIME())
    );
IF OBJECT_ID(N'dash.AccessProfileRole', N'U') IS NULL
    CREATE TABLE dash.AccessProfileRole
    (
        ProfileId   INT             NOT NULL CONSTRAINT FK_DashAccessProfileRole_Profile REFERENCES dash.AccessProfile (ProfileId) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        Role        VARCHAR(32)     NOT NULL CONSTRAINT CK_DashAccessProfileRole_Role CHECK (Role IN
                        ('Admin', 'Organization', 'Adoption', 'Licensing', 'Security', 'Compliance', 'Agents', 'Enablement', 'Governance', 'GovernanceOperator', 'GovernanceAuditor', 'Restricted')),
        OrgWide     BIT             NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_DashAccessProfileRole_OrgWide DEFAULT (0),
        Pages       NVARCHAR(1000)  NULL,       -- for Admin: the Admin pages, as on dash.RoleGrant; NULL is every page
        CONSTRAINT PK_DashAccessProfileRole PRIMARY KEY (ProfileId, Role)
    );
IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.check_constraints WHERE name = N'CK_DashAccessProfileRole_Role' AND parent_object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'dash.AccessProfileRole') AND definition NOT LIKE N'%Restricted%')
BEGIN
    ALTER TABLE dash.AccessProfileRole DROP CONSTRAINT CK_DashAccessProfileRole_Role;
    ALTER TABLE dash.AccessProfileRole ADD CONSTRAINT CK_DashAccessProfileRole_Role CHECK (Role IN
        ('Admin', 'Organization', 'Adoption', 'Licensing', 'Security', 'Compliance', 'Agents', 'Enablement', 'Governance', 'GovernanceOperator', 'GovernanceAuditor', 'Restricted'));
END;
IF OBJECT_ID(N'dash.ProfileGrant', N'U') IS NULL
    CREATE TABLE dash.ProfileGrant
    (
        GrantId           INT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT PK_DashProfileGrant PRIMARY KEY,
        Principal         NVARCHAR(256)   NOT NULL,   -- a UPN, DOMAIN\name, or entra:<object ID>, as on dash.RoleGrant
        PrincipalType     VARCHAR(8)      NOT NULL CONSTRAINT CK_DashProfileGrant_Type CHECK (PrincipalType IN ('User', 'Group')),
        PrincipalObjectId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL,
        PrincipalName     NVARCHAR(256)   NULL,
        ProfileId         INT             NOT NULL CONSTRAINT FK_DashProfileGrant_Profile REFERENCES dash.AccessProfile (ProfileId),
        Note              NVARCHAR(400)   NULL,
        GrantedBy         NVARCHAR(256)   NOT NULL,
        GrantedUtc        DATETIME2(0)    NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_DashProfileGrant_Granted DEFAULT (SYSUTCDATETIME()),
        CONSTRAINT UQ_DashProfileGrant UNIQUE (Principal, ProfileId)
    );

/* Friendly names and owners for agents, set by an administrator: they come before the name the audit log gives. */
IF OBJECT_ID(N'dash.AgentAlias', N'U') IS NULL
    CREATE TABLE dash.AgentAlias
    (
        AgentKey     INT             NOT NULL CONSTRAINT PK_DashAgentAlias PRIMARY KEY,   -- bi.DimAgent, whose keys are stable
        FriendlyName NVARCHAR(200)   NOT NULL,
        Owner        NVARCHAR(256)   NULL,
        Notes        NVARCHAR(400)   NULL,
        UpdatedBy    NVARCHAR(256)   NOT NULL,
        UpdatedUtc   DATETIME2(0)    NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_DashAgentAlias_Updated DEFAULT (SYSUTCDATETIME())
    );

/* Names for sensitivity labels, which the audit log records by ID only. */
IF OBJECT_ID(N'dash.SensitivityLabel', N'U') IS NULL
    CREATE TABLE dash.SensitivityLabel
    (
        LabelId     NVARCHAR(64)    NOT NULL CONSTRAINT PK_DashSensitivityLabel PRIMARY KEY,   -- the label GUID
        Name        NVARCHAR(200)   NOT NULL,
        Rank        TINYINT         NULL,       -- ordering, least to most sensitive
        UpdatedBy   NVARCHAR(256)   NOT NULL,
        UpdatedUtc  DATETIME2(0)    NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_DashSensitivityLabel_Updated DEFAULT (SYSUTCDATETIME())
    );

/* Every page view, denial, export and admin change. */
IF OBJECT_ID(N'dash.AuditLog', N'U') IS NULL
    CREATE TABLE dash.AuditLog
    (
        LogId     BIGINT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT PK_DashAuditLog PRIMARY KEY,
        AtUtc     DATETIME2(0)    NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_DashAuditLog_At DEFAULT (SYSUTCDATETIME()),
        Viewer    NVARCHAR(256)   NOT NULL,   -- the resolved UPN, or the Windows name if none
        Kind      VARCHAR(12)     NOT NULL,   -- View | Denied | Export | Admin
        Page      NVARCHAR(200)   NULL,
        Scope     NVARCHAR(400)   NULL,       -- Organization, or the subtree root shown
        Detail    NVARCHAR(2000)  NULL,       -- filters, or what an admin change did
        ClientIp  VARCHAR(64)     NULL,
        INDEX IX_DashAuditLog_At (AtUtc),
        INDEX IX_DashAuditLog_Viewer (Viewer, AtUtc)
    );

/* What a change submitted and altered, as JSON: the values posted (a secret's masked) and the settings and role grants
   before and after, written in the same transaction as the change itself. */
IF COL_LENGTH(N'dash.AuditLog', N'Change') IS NULL
    ALTER TABLE dash.AuditLog ADD Change NVARCHAR(MAX) NULL;

/* Built by dash.usp_RefreshDashboard. */
IF OBJECT_ID(N'dash.Person', N'U') IS NULL
    CREATE TABLE dash.Person
    (
        Upn            NVARCHAR(256)   NOT NULL CONSTRAINT PK_DashPerson PRIMARY KEY,
        DisplayName    NVARCHAR(256)   NULL,
        ManagerUpn     NVARCHAR(256)   NULL,
        Department     NVARCHAR(200)   NULL,
        AccountEnabled BIT             NULL,
        Level          TINYINT         NULL,   -- 1 = OrgTopUpn, 2 = reports to them, ...; NULL when not under the top (or no top set)
        DirectReports  INT             NOT NULL,
        PeopleBelow    INT             NOT NULL,   -- everyone under them, at any depth
        INDEX IX_DashPerson_Manager (ManagerUpn)
    );

/* The person's Windows account SID, from audit.UserDirectory: how a sign-in is matched to a person. */
IF COL_LENGTH(N'dash.Person', N'Sid') IS NULL
    ALTER TABLE dash.Person ADD Sid VARCHAR(184) NULL;
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.indexes WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'dash.Person') AND name = N'IX_DashPerson_Sid')
    EXEC (N'CREATE INDEX IX_DashPerson_Sid ON dash.Person (Sid);');
/* The person's Entra ID object ID, from the license tool's lookup: how a sign-in through Entra ID is matched first. */
IF COL_LENGTH(N'dash.Person', N'ObjectId') IS NULL
    ALTER TABLE dash.Person ADD ObjectId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL;
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.indexes WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'dash.Person') AND name = N'IX_DashPerson_ObjectId')
    EXEC (N'CREATE INDEX IX_DashPerson_ObjectId ON dash.Person (ObjectId);');

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dash.OrgClosure', N'U') IS NULL
    CREATE TABLE dash.OrgClosure
    (
        AncestorUpn   NVARCHAR(256)   NOT NULL,
        DescendantUpn NVARCHAR(256)   NOT NULL,
        Depth         TINYINT         NOT NULL,   -- 0 = the person themselves
        /* Nonclustered: two UPNs can exceed a clustered key's 900 bytes. It
           covers the lookup (ancestor to the people under them) on its own. */
        CONSTRAINT PK_DashOrgClosure PRIMARY KEY NONCLUSTERED (AncestorUpn, DescendantUpn)
    );

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dash.UserDay', N'U') IS NULL
    CREATE TABLE dash.UserDay
    (
        DateKey           INT     NOT NULL,   -- bi.DimDate, in the reporting time zone
        UserKey           INT     NOT NULL,   -- bi.DimUser
        Interactions      INT     NOT NULL,
        Prompts           INT     NOT NULL,
        AppsUsed          TINYINT NOT NULL,
        AgentInteractions INT     NOT NULL,   -- interactions with an agent, not Copilot itself
        WebGrounded       INT     NOT NULL,
        ChatInteractions  INT     NOT NULL,   -- in Copilot Chat apps (bi.DimApp.AppCategory)
        LicensedUse       INT     NOT NULL,   -- interactions made while licensed
        Jailbreak         INT     NOT NULL,
        PromptInjection   INT     NOT NULL,
        BlockedResource   INT     NOT NULL,
        LabeledContent   INT     NOT NULL,   -- interactions that touched sensitivity-labeled content
        Sessions          INT     NOT NULL,   -- sessions that started that day
        MultiTurnSessions INT     NOT NULL,
        PremiumUse        INT     NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_DashUserDay_Premium DEFAULT (0),   -- licensed interactions that needed the license
        CONSTRAINT PK_DashUserDay PRIMARY KEY (DateKey, UserKey),
        INDEX IX_DashUserDay_User (UserKey, DateKey)
    );

/* Use that needs the Premium license. Zero until the rollups are rebuilt once (dash.usp_RefreshDashboard with no date). */
IF COL_LENGTH(N'dash.UserDay', N'PremiumUse') IS NULL
    ALTER TABLE dash.UserDay ADD PremiumUse INT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_DashUserDay_Premium DEFAULT (0);

/*
    Sensitivity labels and SharePoint sites Copilot touched, per person per day:
    Label (a label id on content an interaction read), Site (the site of labeled
    content it read) and Blocked (the site of content it was blocked from). Sites
    are cut to https://host/sites/name, or /personal/name for OneDrive.
*/
IF OBJECT_ID(N'dash.ResourceDay', N'U') IS NULL
    CREATE TABLE dash.ResourceDay
    (
        DateKey      INT            NOT NULL,
        UserKey      INT            NOT NULL,
        Kind         VARCHAR(8)     NOT NULL CONSTRAINT CK_DashResourceDay_Kind CHECK (Kind IN ('Label', 'Site', 'Blocked')),
        Item         NVARCHAR(400)  NOT NULL,
        Interactions INT            NOT NULL,
        CONSTRAINT PK_DashResourceDay PRIMARY KEY (DateKey, Kind, UserKey, Item)
    );

/*
    The interactions with a security signal, a few in every thousand, each with the record id the triage
    is kept under. Security > Flagged interactions lists them from here: reading the record ids of the flagged
    rows out of bi.FactInteraction costs a pass over that column for the whole fact (4 seconds at 40 million).
*/
IF OBJECT_ID(N'dash.FlaggedInteraction', N'U') IS NULL
BEGIN
    CREATE TABLE dash.FlaggedInteraction
    (
        DateKey                 INT           NOT NULL,
        UserKey                 INT           NOT NULL,
        RecordId                NVARCHAR(450) NOT NULL,
        ActivityHour            DATETIME2(0)  NOT NULL,
        AppKey                  INT           NOT NULL,
        AgentKey                INT           NOT NULL,
        JailbreakDetected       BIT           NOT NULL,
        PromptInjectionDetected BIT           NOT NULL,
        HasBlockedResource      BIT           NOT NULL
    );
    CREATE CLUSTERED INDEX CX_DashFlaggedInteraction ON dash.FlaggedInteraction (DateKey, UserKey);
END;

/*
    Columnstore copies of the two rollups. The pages read a year of them
    for a whole organization at a time (6 and 12 million rows at 70,000 people),
    which the row-store keys scan in seconds and a columnstore in a fraction of
    one. The refresh truncates and bulk-loads both, which a columnstore takes.
*/
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.indexes WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'dash.UserDay') AND name = N'NCCI_DashUserDay')
    EXEC (N'CREATE NONCLUSTERED COLUMNSTORE INDEX NCCI_DashUserDay ON dash.UserDay
          (DateKey, UserKey, Interactions, Prompts, AppsUsed, AgentInteractions, WebGrounded, ChatInteractions, LicensedUse,
           Jailbreak, PromptInjection, BlockedResource, LabeledContent, Sessions, MultiTurnSessions, PremiumUse);');
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.indexes WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'dash.ResourceDay') AND name = N'NCCI_DashResourceDay')
    EXEC (N'CREATE NONCLUSTERED COLUMNSTORE INDEX NCCI_DashResourceDay ON dash.ResourceDay (DateKey, UserKey, Kind, Item, Interactions);');

/* When each agent was first and last used: bi.DimAgent.FirstSeenUtc is when a refresh first saw it. */
IF OBJECT_ID(N'dash.AgentUse', N'U') IS NULL
    CREATE TABLE dash.AgentUse
    (
        AgentKey     INT     NOT NULL CONSTRAINT PK_DashAgentUse PRIMARY KEY,
        FirstDateKey INT     NOT NULL,
        LastDateKey  INT     NOT NULL,
        Interactions BIGINT  NOT NULL
    );

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dash.RefreshRun', N'U') IS NULL
    CREATE TABLE dash.RefreshRun
    (
        RunId        INT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT PK_DashRefreshRun PRIMARY KEY,
        StartedUtc   DATETIME2(0)  NOT NULL,
        EndedUtc     DATETIME2(0)  NOT NULL,
        SinceUtc     DATETIME2(0)  NULL,       -- NULL: every day rebuilt
        FromDateKey  INT           NULL,
        People       INT           NOT NULL,
        ClosureRows  INT           NOT NULL,
        UserDayRows  INT           NOT NULL
    );
/* The latest bi.RefreshRun the rollups reflect, so the next refresh sees what bi changed since. */
IF COL_LENGTH(N'dash.RefreshRun', N'BiRunId') IS NULL
    ALTER TABLE dash.RefreshRun ADD BiRunId INT NULL;

/*
    The people a scope covers, as bi.DimUser keys: @RootUpn and everyone under
    them. The app passes the viewer's own UPN, or a manager inside their scope
    when they drill in; a whole-organization view with no drill-in does not
    call it at all.
*/
EXEC (N'
CREATE OR ALTER FUNCTION dash.fnScopeUsers (@RootUpn NVARCHAR(256))
RETURNS TABLE
AS
RETURN
SELECT u.UserKey
FROM dash.OrgClosure AS c
JOIN bi.DimUser AS u ON u.UserPrincipalName = c.DescendantUpn
WHERE c.AncestorUpn = @RootUpn;');

/*
    The agent inventory, from the Excel workbook tools/Import-AgentWorkbook.ps1 loads each night. One row per
    agent the workbook lists (the current agents), matched to the agent the audit log knows (AgentKey) where it can
    be. The workbook's sheets themselves are in dbo, as they come; these are what the reports read.
*/
IF OBJECT_ID(N'dash.AgentInventory', N'U') IS NULL
    CREATE TABLE dash.AgentInventory
    (
        InventoryAgentId  NVARCHAR(100)  NOT NULL CONSTRAINT PK_DashAgentInventory PRIMARY KEY,   -- the workbook's AgentId
        AgentKey          INT            NULL,           -- bi.DimAgent, when the audit log knows the agent
        AgentName         NVARCHAR(400)  NULL,
        OwnerUpn          NVARCHAR(256)  NULL,
        Environment       NVARCHAR(400)  NULL,
        SchemaName        NVARCHAR(400)  NULL,
        CreatedAt         DATETIME2(0)   NULL,
        LastPublishedAt   DATETIME2(0)   NULL,
        Channels          NVARCHAR(400)  NULL,
        ViewerUsers       INT            NULL,
        ViewerGroups      INT            NULL,
        EditorUsers       INT            NULL,
        EditorGroups      INT            NULL,
        IsShared          AS CAST(CASE WHEN ViewerUsers > 0 OR ViewerGroups > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS BIT),
        InProduction      BIT            NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_DashAgentInventory_Prod DEFAULT (0),   -- listed on AgentsInProd
        LoadedUtc         DATETIME2(0)   NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_DashAgentInventory_Loaded DEFAULT (SYSUTCDATETIME()),
        INDEX IX_DashAgentInventory_AgentKey (AgentKey)
    );

/* Connected agents: which parent agent calls which child, from the workbook's ParentChildAgent sheet. */
IF OBJECT_ID(N'dash.AgentChildLink', N'U') IS NULL
    CREATE TABLE dash.AgentChildLink
    (
        LinkId                  INT IDENTITY(1, 1) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT PK_DashAgentChildLink PRIMARY KEY,
        ChildAgentName          NVARCHAR(400)  NOT NULL,
        ParentInventoryAgentId  NVARCHAR(100)  NULL,
        ParentAgentName         NVARCHAR(400)  NULL,
        ParentAgentKey          INT            NULL,     -- bi.DimAgent, through the parent's inventory row
        RelationshipType        NVARCHAR(200)  NULL,
        IsValid                 BIT            NULL
    );

/* Which child it is. A name alone is not: Copilot Studio calls a new child agent "Agent", in every parent. A
   child agent lives inside its parent (its own component id); a connected agent is an agent of its own, which several
   parents can call (its environment and schema name, and its row in the inventory where it has one). */
IF COL_LENGTH(N'dash.AgentChildLink', N'ChildKey') IS NULL ALTER TABLE dash.AgentChildLink ADD ChildKey NVARCHAR(450) NULL;
IF COL_LENGTH(N'dash.AgentChildLink', N'ChildKind') IS NULL ALTER TABLE dash.AgentChildLink ADD ChildKind NVARCHAR(20) NULL;   -- Child, Connected
IF COL_LENGTH(N'dash.AgentChildLink', N'ChildInventoryAgentId') IS NULL ALTER TABLE dash.AgentChildLink ADD ChildInventoryAgentId NVARCHAR(100) NULL;
IF COL_LENGTH(N'dash.AgentChildLink', N'ParentEnvironment') IS NULL ALTER TABLE dash.AgentChildLink ADD ParentEnvironment NVARCHAR(400) NULL;

/* The settings the agent checks compare with the agents' use, and whether an agent runs on its own. An agent
   with triggers or flows (an autonomous agent) can work with nobody chatting to it, so no interaction is not "unused". */
IF COL_LENGTH(N'dash.AgentInventory', N'EnvironmentSku') IS NULL ALTER TABLE dash.AgentInventory ADD EnvironmentSku NVARCHAR(100) NULL;
IF COL_LENGTH(N'dash.AgentInventory', N'Authentication') IS NULL ALTER TABLE dash.AgentInventory ADD Authentication NVARCHAR(200) NULL;
IF COL_LENGTH(N'dash.AgentInventory', N'IsQuarantined') IS NULL ALTER TABLE dash.AgentInventory ADD IsQuarantined BIT NULL;
IF COL_LENGTH(N'dash.AgentInventory', N'IsWebSearchEnabled') IS NULL ALTER TABLE dash.AgentInventory ADD IsWebSearchEnabled BIT NULL;
IF COL_LENGTH(N'dash.AgentInventory', N'IsAutonomous') IS NULL
    ALTER TABLE dash.AgentInventory ADD IsAutonomous BIT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_DashAgentInventory_Autonomous DEFAULT (0);

/* Each workbook load, for Admin > Health: when, which file, and what reached the tables. */
IF OBJECT_ID(N'dash.AgentInventoryRun', N'U') IS NULL
    CREATE TABLE dash.AgentInventoryRun
    (
        RunId           INT IDENTITY(1, 1) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT PK_DashAgentInventoryRun PRIMARY KEY,
        StartedUtc      DATETIME2(0)    NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_DashAgentInventoryRun_Started DEFAULT (SYSUTCDATETIME()),
        EndedUtc        DATETIME2(0)    NULL,
        Source          NVARCHAR(800)   NULL,            -- the file, and where it came from
        FileCreatedUtc  DATETIME2(0)    NULL,
        InventoryRows   INT             NULL,
        ProductionRows  INT             NULL,
        ChildLinkRows   INT             NULL,
        Matched         INT             NULL,            -- inventory agents the audit log knows
        Status          NVARCHAR(20)    NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_DashAgentInventoryRun_Status DEFAULT (N'Running'),
        Message         NVARCHAR(2000)  NULL
    );

/* Agents with their friendly names: the agent workbook's first, as the list of the current agents; then one set
   by hand in Admin, for an agent the workbook does not name (one since deleted); then the audit log's. */
EXEC (N'
CREATE OR ALTER VIEW dash.Agent
AS
SELECT a.AgentKey, a.AgentId, a.AgentSource,
       COALESCE(NULLIF(inv.AgentName, N''''), al.FriendlyName, a.AgentName, a.AgentId) AS AgentName,
       a.AgentName AS AuditName, COALESCE(inv.OwnerUpn, al.Owner) AS Owner,
       COALESCE(CAST(fd.[Date] AS DATETIME2(0)), a.FirstSeenUtc) AS FirstSeenUtc,   -- first used, in the reporting zone
       inv.InventoryAgentId, CAST(ISNULL(inv.IsShared, 0) AS BIT) AS IsShared, CAST(ISNULL(inv.InProduction, 0) AS BIT) AS InProduction
FROM bi.DimAgent AS a
LEFT JOIN dash.AgentAlias AS al ON al.AgentKey = a.AgentKey
LEFT JOIN dash.AgentUse AS u ON u.AgentKey = a.AgentKey
LEFT JOIN bi.DimDate AS fd ON fd.DateKey = u.FirstDateKey
OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP (1) i.InventoryAgentId, i.AgentName, i.OwnerUpn, i.IsShared, i.InProduction
             FROM dash.AgentInventory AS i WHERE i.AgentKey = a.AgentKey
             ORDER BY i.InProduction DESC, i.LastPublishedAt DESC, i.InventoryAgentId) AS inv
/* 2.6.3: an agent the audit log names two ways is one agent here, under the identity its interactions are kept with. */
WHERE a.MergedIntoKey IS NULL;');

================================================================================
FILE: tools/Invoke-CopilotMaintenance.ps1
================================================================================
<#
.SYNOPSIS
    Day-to-day tasks on the Copilot audit database, so nobody types SQL by hand.

.DESCRIPTION
    -Task Status               What is loaded and built, and when each step last ran.
    -Task Reflatten            Flatten every record again, then rebuild sessions, bi and
                               the dashboard (after a flattening change).
    -Task RebuildSessions      Rebuild every session (after a session setting changes), then
                               bring bi and the dashboard up to date.
    -Task RebuildBi            Rebuild bi in full (after a time-zone change, license history
                               arriving late, or a purge of flattened rows), then the dashboard.
    -Task RefreshDashboard     Rebuild the dashboard's org chart, and its rollups from -SinceUtc
                               (every day when omitted).
    -Task SetAppCategory       Put -App in -Category (Copilot Chat or In-App Copilot). Add -Apply
                               to rebuild sessions and bi with it now rather than on the next load.
    -Task GrantRole            Give -Principal (a UPN, DOMAIN\user or DOMAIN\Group) a dashboard -Role.
    -Task RevokeRole           Take it away again.
    -Task SetOrgTop            Make -Upn the top of the organization for the dashboard, or -Clear
                               to go back to the one found in the org chart. Rebuilds the org chart.
    -Task SetDashboardSetting  Set MinGroupSize, DefaultDays, InactiveDays, LicenseMonthlyCost,
                               LicenseCurrency, PaygInteractionCost, MaxViewerLevel or ProtectedLevels to -Value.
                               MaxViewerLevel 0 opens the dashboard to everyone; 1 to 15 to
                               levels 1 to that below the top, and anyone granted a role.
                               ProtectedLevels N keeps levels 1 to N off every revoke and
                               train list (5 by default; 0 for none).
    -Task NameAgent            Give the agent -AgentId (its id in the audit log) a -FriendlyName
                               (and -Owner). An empty -FriendlyName removes the name.
    -Task NameLabel            Give the sensitivity label -LabelId a -Name (and -Rank, 0 least sensitive).
    -Task PurgeJson            Clear the stored JSON of records older than -RetainDays (with
                               -DeleteRows, remove those records altogether: the record, its
                               shredded and flattened rows, and the resources and contexts it
                               read; -Task RebuildBi then takes them out of bi and the
                               dashboard). Reports only, unless -Apply.
    -Task RebuildValueCatalog  List every distinct value of the cataloged columns again, from
                               every flattened record: once, for data flattened before 2.3.0.
    -Task ListValues           The cataloged columns, or with -ColumnId one column's values
                               and names; -Path writes them to a CSV to fill in.
    -Task ImportValueNames     Readable names for cataloged values from -Path, a CSV of
                               ColumnId, Value, Name[, Note] (what ListValues -Path writes).
                               An empty Name removes the name.

    Most of these are also in the dashboard's Admin pages; this is the same for
    servers without it, and for scripts.

.EXAMPLE
    .\tools\Invoke-CopilotMaintenance.ps1 -SqlServer SQLPROD01 -Task Status
.EXAMPLE
    .\tools\Invoke-CopilotMaintenance.ps1 -SqlServer SQLPROD01 -Task SetAppCategory -App 'Copilot Notebooks' -Category 'Copilot Chat' -Apply
.EXAMPLE
    .\tools\Invoke-CopilotMaintenance.ps1 -SqlServer SQLPROD01 -Task GrantRole -Principal 'CONTOSO\Copilot-Insights-Admins' -Role Admin
#>
#Requires -Version 5.1
[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [Parameter(Mandatory)][string] $SqlServer,
    [string] $Database = 'CopilotAudit',
    # The license databases sessions and bi read. Left out: the ones this database's last build used.
    [string[]] $LicenseEventDatabases,
    [pscredential] $SqlCredential,
    [switch] $TrustServerCertificate,
    [Parameter(Mandatory)]
    [ValidateSet('Status', 'Reflatten', 'RebuildSessions', 'RebuildBi', 'RefreshDashboard', 'SetAppCategory', 'GrantRole',
                 'RevokeRole', 'SetOrgTop', 'SetDashboardSetting', 'NameAgent', 'NameLabel', 'PurgeJson',
                 'RebuildValueCatalog', 'ListValues', 'ImportValueNames')]
    [string] $Task,
    [string] $App,
    [ValidateSet('Copilot Chat', 'In-App Copilot')][string] $Category,
    [string] $Principal,
    [ValidateSet('Admin', 'Organization', 'Adoption', 'Licensing', 'Security', 'Compliance', 'Agents', 'Enablement', 'Restricted')][string] $Role,
    [string] $Note,
    [ValidateSet('User', 'Group')][string] $PrincipalType,
    [string] $Upn,
    [switch] $Clear,
    [ValidateSet('MinGroupSize', 'DefaultDays', 'InactiveDays', 'LicenseMonthlyCost', 'LicenseCurrency', 'PaygInteractionCost', 'MaxViewerLevel', 'ProtectedLevels')][string] $Name,
    [string] $Value,
    [string] $AgentId,
    [string] $FriendlyName,
    [string] $Owner,
    [string] $LabelId,
    [ValidateRange(0, 250)][int] $Rank = -1,
    [datetime] $SinceUtc,
    [ValidateRange(1, 3650)][int] $RetainDays = 365,
    [switch] $Apply,
    # PurgeJson: remove the old records altogether, not only their JSON.
    [switch] $DeleteRows,
    # ListValues: one column of audit.ValueCatalogColumn.
    [int] $ColumnId,
    # ListValues writes, ImportValueNames reads: a CSV of ColumnId, Value, Name, Note.
    [string] $Path
)

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$me = "$env:USERDOMAIN\$env:USERNAME"

function Invoke-Sql {
    param([string] $Sql, [hashtable] $Parameters = @{}, [switch] $Table, [switch] $Scalar)
    $b = New-Object System.Data.SqlClient.SqlConnectionStringBuilder
    $b['Data Source'] = $SqlServer; $b['Initial Catalog'] = $Database
    if ($SqlCredential) { $b['User ID'] = $SqlCredential.UserName; $b['Password'] = $SqlCredential.GetNetworkCredential().Password }
    else { $b['Integrated Security'] = $true }
    $b['Encrypt'] = $true; $b['TrustServerCertificate'] = [bool] $TrustServerCertificate; $b['Application Name'] = 'Invoke-CopilotMaintenance'
    $conn = New-Object System.Data.SqlClient.SqlConnection $b.ConnectionString
    $conn.add_InfoMessage({ param($s, $e) foreach ($m in $e.Errors) { if ($m.Class -le 10 -and $m.Message -notlike 'Warning: Null value*') { Write-Host "  $($m.Message)" -ForegroundColor DarkGray } } })
    $conn.Open()
    try {
        $cmd = $conn.CreateCommand(); $cmd.CommandText = $Sql; $cmd.CommandTimeout = 0
        foreach ($k in $Parameters.Keys) { [void] $cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue($k, $(if ($null -eq $Parameters[$k]) { [DBNull]::Value } else { $Parameters[$k] })) }
        if ($Scalar) { return $cmd.ExecuteScalar() }
        if ($Table) { $t = New-Object System.Data.DataTable; $r = $cmd.ExecuteReader(); try { $t.Load($r) } finally { $r.Dispose() }; return , $t }
        [void] $cmd.ExecuteNonQuery()
    }
    finally { $conn.Dispose() }
}
function Test-Proc([string] $n) { [bool] (Invoke-Sql -Scalar -Sql "SELECT CASE WHEN OBJECT_ID(@n, N'P') IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END" -Parameters @{ '@n' = $n }) }
function Need([string] $what, $value) { if (-not $value) { throw "-Task $Task needs -$what." } }
function Update-Dashboard([object] $since) {
    if (Test-Proc 'dash.usp_RefreshDashboard') { Invoke-Sql -Sql 'EXEC dash.usp_RefreshDashboard @SinceUtc = @s;' -Parameters @{ '@s' = $since } }
}
# The license databases: those given, else the ones this database's last session build used, else its last
# bi refresh's, else none. The default was CopilotLicenseEvents, which is the first tenant's: another tenant's
# maintenance read that tenant's license history, and its nightly then failed every night on the change.
if (-not $PSBoundParameters.ContainsKey('LicenseEventDatabases')) {
    $recorded = Invoke-Sql -Scalar -Sql @"
DECLARE @l NVARCHAR(1000), @found BIT = 0;
IF OBJECT_ID(N'audit.CopilotSessionRun', N'U') IS NOT NULL
    SELECT TOP (1) @l = LicenseEventDatabase, @found = 1 FROM audit.CopilotSessionRun ORDER BY RunId DESC;
IF @found = 0 AND OBJECT_ID(N'bi.RefreshRun', N'U') IS NOT NULL
    SELECT TOP (1) @l = LicenseEventDatabase FROM bi.RefreshRun ORDER BY RunId DESC;
SELECT @l;
"@
    $LicenseEventDatabases = if ($recorded -is [DBNull] -or [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace([string] $recorded)) { @() }
                             else { @(([string] $recorded) -split ',' | ForEach-Object { $_.Trim() } | Where-Object { $_ }) }
    if ($Task -in 'Reflatten', 'RebuildSessions', 'RebuildBi', 'SetAppCategory') {
        Write-Host $(if ($LicenseEventDatabases) { "  License history from $($LicenseEventDatabases -join ', '), as $Database's last build (-LicenseEventDatabases to change it)." }
                     else { "  No license history: $Database's last build read none (-LicenseEventDatabases to name it)." }) -ForegroundColor DarkGray
    }
}
$licList = if ($LicenseEventDatabases) { $LicenseEventDatabases -join ',' } else { $null }
function Update-Bi([object] $since) { Invoke-Sql -Sql 'EXEC bi.usp_RefreshBi @SinceUtc = @s, @LicenseEventDatabase = @l;' -Parameters @{ '@s' = $since; '@l' = $licList } }

# The tasks that rebuild hold the database while they work, as the nightly pipeline and Install-CopilotAudit.ps1
# do: an exclusive application lock, on a connection of its own kept open until the task ends. A rebuild that ran beside
# the nightly rebuilt bi under the nightly's own refresh, counting interactions twice.
$runLock = $null
if ($Task -in 'Reflatten', 'RebuildSessions', 'RebuildBi', 'RebuildValueCatalog' -or ($Apply -and $Task -in 'SetAppCategory', 'PurgeJson')) {
    $lb = New-Object System.Data.SqlClient.SqlConnectionStringBuilder
    $lb['Data Source'] = $SqlServer; $lb['Initial Catalog'] = $Database
    if ($SqlCredential) { $lb['User ID'] = $SqlCredential.UserName; $lb['Password'] = $SqlCredential.GetNetworkCredential().Password }
    else { $lb['Integrated Security'] = $true }
    $lb['Encrypt'] = $true; $lb['TrustServerCertificate'] = [bool] $TrustServerCertificate; $lb['Application Name'] = 'Invoke-CopilotMaintenance'
    $lb['Pooling'] = $false   # closing a pooled connection keeps its session, and the session's lock with it
    $runLock = New-Object System.Data.SqlClient.SqlConnection $lb.ConnectionString
    $runLock.Open()
    $lc = $runLock.CreateCommand()
    $lc.CommandText = "DECLARE @r INT; EXEC @r = sp_getapplock @Resource = N'CopilotAudit.Run', @LockMode = 'Exclusive', @LockOwner = 'Session', @LockTimeout = 0; SELECT @r;"
    if ([int] $lc.ExecuteScalar() -lt 0) {
        $runLock.Dispose()
        throw "Another run is using $Database now: the nightly pipeline, the installer or another rebuild. Nothing was changed. Let it finish (Admin > Health shows the pipeline's runs), then run this again."
    }
}

try {
switch ($Task) {
    'Status' {
        $t = Invoke-Sql -Table -Sql @"
SELECT 'Records' AS Item, CAST((SELECT SUM(row_count) FROM sys.dm_db_partition_stats WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'audit.CopilotAudit') AND index_id IN (0,1)) AS NVARCHAR(40)) AS Value
UNION ALL SELECT 'Flattened', CAST((SELECT SUM(row_count) FROM sys.dm_db_partition_stats WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'audit.RawLogFlattened') AND index_id IN (0,1)) AS NVARCHAR(40))
UNION ALL SELECT 'Last load merged (UTC)', CASE WHEN OBJECT_ID(N'audit.CopilotLoad') IS NOT NULL THEN (SELECT CONVERT(NVARCHAR(20), MAX(MergedUtc), 120) FROM audit.CopilotLoad) END
UNION ALL SELECT 'Last session build (UTC)', CASE WHEN OBJECT_ID(N'audit.CopilotSessionRun') IS NOT NULL THEN (SELECT CONVERT(NVARCHAR(20), MAX(RunEndUtc), 120) FROM audit.CopilotSessionRun) END
UNION ALL SELECT 'Last bi refresh (UTC)', CASE WHEN OBJECT_ID(N'bi.RefreshRun') IS NOT NULL THEN (SELECT CONVERT(NVARCHAR(20), MAX(EndedUtc), 120) FROM bi.RefreshRun) END
UNION ALL SELECT 'Last dashboard refresh (UTC)', CASE WHEN OBJECT_ID(N'dash.RefreshRun') IS NOT NULL THEN (SELECT CONVERT(NVARCHAR(20), MAX(EndedUtc), 120) FROM dash.RefreshRun) END
UNION ALL SELECT 'Directory people', CASE WHEN OBJECT_ID(N'audit.UserDirectory') IS NOT NULL THEN CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM audit.UserDirectory) AS NVARCHAR(40)) END
UNION ALL SELECT 'Top of the organization', CASE WHEN OBJECT_ID(N'dash.Setting') IS NOT NULL THEN
    (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN Name = 'OrgTopUpn' THEN NULLIF(Value, N'') END), MAX(CASE WHEN Name = 'OrgTopUpnDetected' THEN Value + N' (from the org chart)' END)) FROM dash.Setting) END
UNION ALL SELECT 'Record shapes', CASE WHEN OBJECT_ID(N'audit.RawLogRecordShape') IS NOT NULL THEN CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM audit.RawLogRecordShape) AS NVARCHAR(40)) END;
"@
        $t.Rows | ForEach-Object { '{0,-30} {1}' -f $_.Item, $(if ($_.Value -is [DBNull]) { '-' } else { $_.Value }) }
    }
    'Reflatten' {
        Invoke-Sql -Sql 'EXEC audit.usp_FlattenCopilotAudit;'
        Invoke-Sql -Sql 'EXEC audit.usp_BuildCopilotSessions @LicenseEventDatabase = @l;' -Parameters @{ '@l' = $licList }
        Update-Bi $null; Update-Dashboard $null
    }
    'RebuildSessions' {
        Invoke-Sql -Sql 'EXEC audit.usp_BuildCopilotSessions @LicenseEventDatabase = @l;' -Parameters @{ '@l' = $licList }
        # After a full session build bi copies every session again; interactions from today on only.
        Update-Bi ([datetime]::UtcNow.Date); Update-Dashboard $null
    }
    'RebuildBi' { Update-Bi $null; Update-Dashboard $null }
    'RefreshDashboard' { Update-Dashboard $(if ($PSBoundParameters.ContainsKey('SinceUtc')) { $SinceUtc } else { $null }) }
    'SetAppCategory' {
        Need 'App' $App; Need 'Category' $Category
        Invoke-Sql -Parameters @{ '@a' = $App; '@c' = $Category } -Sql @"
UPDATE audit.SessionAppCategory SET AppCategory = @c WHERE App = @a;
IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0 INSERT INTO audit.SessionAppCategory (App, AppCategory) VALUES (@a, @c);
"@
        Write-Host "$App is $Category."
        if ($Apply) {
            Invoke-Sql -Sql 'EXEC audit.usp_BuildCopilotSessions @LicenseEventDatabase = @l;' -Parameters @{ '@l' = $licList }
            Update-Bi $null; Update-Dashboard $null
        }
        else { Write-Host 'It applies from the next load; add -Apply to rebuild sessions and bi with it now.' }
    }
    'GrantRole' {
        Need 'Principal' $Principal; Need 'Role' $Role
        if (-not $Principal.Contains('@') -and -not $Principal.Contains('\')) { throw '-Principal is a UPN, DOMAIN\user or DOMAIN\Group.' }
        # DOMAIN\name: a group if AD says so, else a user.
        $type = if ($PrincipalType) { $PrincipalType } else { 'User' }
        if (-not $PrincipalType -and $Principal.Contains('\')) {
            try {
                Add-Type -AssemblyName System.DirectoryServices.AccountManagement
                $pc = New-Object System.DirectoryServices.AccountManagement.PrincipalContext ([System.DirectoryServices.AccountManagement.ContextType]::Domain), $Principal.Split('\')[0]
                if ([System.DirectoryServices.AccountManagement.GroupPrincipal]::FindByIdentity($pc, $Principal)) { $type = 'Group' }
            }
            catch { Write-Warning "Could not ask AD whether $Principal is a group; recorded as a user (-PrincipalType Group to say otherwise). The dashboard matches it either way." }
        }
        Invoke-Sql -Parameters @{ '@p' = $Principal; '@t' = $type; '@r' = $Role; '@n' = $Note; '@by' = $me } -Sql @"
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dash.RoleGrant WHERE Principal = @p AND Role = @r)
    INSERT INTO dash.RoleGrant (Principal, PrincipalType, Role, Note, GrantedBy) VALUES (@p, @t, @r, @n, @by);
INSERT INTO dash.AuditLog (Viewer, Kind, Page, Detail) VALUES (@by, 'Admin', N'Invoke-CopilotMaintenance', CONCAT(N'Granted ', @r, N' to ', @p));
"@
        Write-Host "$Principal ($type) has $Role."
    }
    'RevokeRole' {
        Need 'Principal' $Principal; Need 'Role' $Role
        Invoke-Sql -Parameters @{ '@p' = $Principal; '@r' = $Role; '@by' = $me } -Sql @"
DELETE FROM dash.RoleGrant WHERE Principal = @p AND Role = @r;
INSERT INTO dash.AuditLog (Viewer, Kind, Page, Detail) VALUES (@by, 'Admin', N'Invoke-CopilotMaintenance', CONCAT(N'Removed ', @r, N' from ', @p));
"@
        Write-Host "$Principal no longer has $Role."
    }
    'SetOrgTop' {
        if (-not $Clear) {
            Need 'Upn' $Upn
            $known = [int] (Invoke-Sql -Scalar -Sql 'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dash.Person WHERE Upn = @u' -Parameters @{ '@u' = $Upn.Trim() })
            if ($known -eq 0) { throw "$Upn is not in the directory the dashboard knows (dash.Person). Load the directory first, or check the UPN." }
        }
        Invoke-Sql -Parameters @{ '@v' = $(if ($Clear) { $null } else { $Upn.Trim() }); '@by' = $me } -Sql @"
UPDATE dash.Setting SET Value = @v, UpdatedBy = @by, UpdatedUtc = SYSUTCDATETIME() WHERE Name = 'OrgTopUpn';
INSERT INTO dash.AuditLog (Viewer, Kind, Page, Detail) VALUES (@by, 'Admin', N'Invoke-CopilotMaintenance', CONCAT(N'OrgTopUpn -> ', ISNULL(@v, N'(from the org chart)')));
"@
        Update-Dashboard ([datetime]::UtcNow.Date)
    }
    'SetDashboardSetting' {
        Need 'Name' $Name; Need 'Value' $Value
        if ($Name -eq 'MaxViewerLevel' -and $Value -notmatch '^(0|[1-9]|1[0-5])$') { throw 'MaxViewerLevel is 0 (everyone) or a level from 1 to 15.' }
        if ($Name -eq 'ProtectedLevels' -and $Value -notmatch '^(0|[1-9]|1[0-5])$') { throw 'ProtectedLevels is 0 (none) or a level from 1 to 15.' }
        Invoke-Sql -Parameters @{ '@n' = $Name; '@v' = $Value; '@by' = $me } -Sql @"
UPDATE dash.Setting SET Value = @v, UpdatedBy = @by, UpdatedUtc = SYSUTCDATETIME() WHERE Name = @n;
IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0 INSERT INTO dash.Setting (Name, Value, UpdatedBy) VALUES (@n, @v, @by);
INSERT INTO dash.AuditLog (Viewer, Kind, Page, Detail) VALUES (@by, 'Admin', N'Invoke-CopilotMaintenance', CONCAT(@n, N' -> ', @v));
"@
        Write-Host "$Name = $Value."
    }
    'NameAgent' {
        Need 'AgentId' $AgentId
        # Either identity of an agent the audit log names two ways names the one agent.
        $key = Invoke-Sql -Scalar -Parameters @{ '@a' = $AgentId } -Sql @'
DECLARE @k INT;
IF COL_LENGTH(N'bi.DimAgent', N'MergedIntoKey') IS NULL SELECT @k = AgentKey FROM bi.DimAgent WHERE AgentId = @a;
ELSE EXEC sp_executesql N'SELECT @k = COALESCE(MergedIntoKey, AgentKey) FROM bi.DimAgent WHERE AgentId = @a', N'@a NVARCHAR(400), @k INT OUTPUT', @a, @k OUTPUT;
SELECT @k;
'@
        if ($null -eq $key -or $key -is [DBNull]) { throw "No agent $AgentId in bi.DimAgent." }
        Invoke-Sql -Parameters @{ '@k' = $key; '@n' = $FriendlyName; '@o' = $Owner; '@by' = $me } -Sql @"
IF NULLIF(@n, N'') IS NULL DELETE FROM dash.AgentAlias WHERE AgentKey = @k;
ELSE BEGIN
    UPDATE dash.AgentAlias SET FriendlyName = @n, Owner = @o, UpdatedBy = @by, UpdatedUtc = SYSUTCDATETIME() WHERE AgentKey = @k;
    IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0 INSERT INTO dash.AgentAlias (AgentKey, FriendlyName, Owner, UpdatedBy) VALUES (@k, @n, @o, @by);
END;
"@
        Write-Host "Agent $AgentId named."
    }
    'NameLabel' {
        Need 'LabelId' $LabelId; Need 'Name' $FriendlyName
        Invoke-Sql -Parameters @{ '@i' = $LabelId.ToLowerInvariant(); '@n' = $FriendlyName; '@r' = $(if ($Rank -ge 0) { $Rank } else { $null }); '@by' = $me } -Sql @"
UPDATE dash.SensitivityLabel SET Name = @n, Rank = @r, UpdatedBy = @by, UpdatedUtc = SYSUTCDATETIME() WHERE LabelId = @i;
IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0 INSERT INTO dash.SensitivityLabel (LabelId, Name, Rank, UpdatedBy) VALUES (@i, @n, @r, @by);
"@
        Write-Host "Label $LabelId is $FriendlyName."
    }
    'RebuildValueCatalog' {
        if (-not (Test-Proc 'audit.usp_CatalogValues')) { throw 'audit.usp_CatalogValues is not installed: run Install-CopilotAudit.ps1 from this release first.' }
        Write-Host 'Reading every flattened record; on a large database this takes a while.'
        Invoke-Sql -Sql 'EXEC audit.usp_CatalogValues @Rebuild = 1;'
        (Invoke-Sql -Table -Sql 'SELECT ColumnId, Label, DistinctValues, Capped FROM audit.ValueCatalogColumn WHERE DistinctValues > 0 ORDER BY ColumnId;').Rows |
            Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String | Write-Host
    }
    'ListValues' {
        if (-not $PSBoundParameters.ContainsKey('ColumnId')) {
            (Invoke-Sql -Table -Sql 'SELECT ColumnId, Label, TableName + N''.'' + ColumnName AS [Column], DistinctValues, CASE WHEN Capped = 1 THEN N''10,000 or more'' ELSE N'''' END AS Capped FROM audit.ValueCatalogColumn ORDER BY ColumnId;').Rows |
                Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String | Write-Host
            Write-Host 'Add -ColumnId to list one column''s values, and -Path to write them to a CSV.'
            break
        }
        $t = Invoke-Sql -Table -Parameters @{ '@c' = $ColumnId } -Sql @"
SELECT v.ColumnId, v.Value, COALESCE(n.Name, CASE WHEN v.ColumnId IN (11, 30) THEN sl.Name END) AS Name, n.Note, v.Records
FROM audit.ValueCatalog AS v
LEFT JOIN dash.ValueName AS n ON n.ColumnId = v.ColumnId AND n.Value = v.Value
LEFT JOIN dash.SensitivityLabel AS sl ON sl.LabelId = v.Value
WHERE v.ColumnId = @c ORDER BY v.Records DESC;
"@
        if ($Path) {
            $t.Rows | Select-Object ColumnId, Value, Name, Note | Export-Csv -LiteralPath $Path -NoTypeInformation -Encoding utf8
            Write-Host "$($t.Rows.Count) value(s) written to $Path. Fill in Name, then run -Task ImportValueNames -Path $Path."
        }
        else { $t.Rows | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String | Write-Host }
    }
    'ImportValueNames' {
        Need 'Path' $Path
        $n = 0; $cleared = 0
        # Not $name: PowerShell names are case-insensitive, and -Name only takes the setting names.
        foreach ($r in Import-Csv -LiteralPath $Path) {
            $col = [int] $r.ColumnId
            $valueName = if ($r.PSObject.Properties['Name'] -and "$($r.Name)".Trim()) { "$($r.Name)".Trim() } else { $null }
            $valueNote = if ($r.PSObject.Properties['Note'] -and "$($r.Note)".Trim()) { "$($r.Note)".Trim() } else { $null }
            $known = [int] (Invoke-Sql -Scalar -Sql 'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM audit.ValueCatalog WHERE ColumnId = @c AND Value = @v' -Parameters @{ '@c' = $col; '@v' = $r.Value })
            if (-not $known) { Write-Warning "Skipped: '$($r.Value)' is not a value of column $col."; continue }
            Invoke-Sql -Parameters @{ '@c' = $col; '@v' = $r.Value; '@n' = $valueName; '@note' = $valueNote; '@by' = $me } -Sql @"
IF @n IS NULL DELETE FROM dash.ValueName WHERE ColumnId = @c AND Value = @v;
ELSE BEGIN
    UPDATE dash.ValueName SET Name = @n, Note = @note, UpdatedBy = @by, UpdatedUtc = SYSUTCDATETIME() WHERE ColumnId = @c AND Value = @v;
    IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0 INSERT INTO dash.ValueName (ColumnId, Value, Name, Note, UpdatedBy) VALUES (@c, @v, @n, @note, @by);
END;
/* Label names also live with their order in dash.SensitivityLabel. */
IF @c IN (11, 30) AND @n IS NOT NULL
BEGIN
    UPDATE dash.SensitivityLabel SET Name = @n, UpdatedBy = @by, UpdatedUtc = SYSUTCDATETIME() WHERE LabelId = @v;
    IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0 INSERT INTO dash.SensitivityLabel (LabelId, Name, UpdatedBy) VALUES (@v, @n, @by);
END;
"@
            if ($valueName) { $n++ } else { $cleared++ }
        }
        Write-Host "$n name(s) saved, $cleared cleared."
    }
    'PurgeJson' {
        # -DeleteRows removes the flattened rows too, with the resources and contexts they read. It kept them,
        # each naming the user and the files and links they read, though the records were said to be gone.
        $t = Invoke-Sql -Table -Sql 'EXEC audit.usp_PurgeCopilotAuditJson @RetainDays = @d, @WhatIf = @w, @DeleteRows = @r, @PurgeFlattened = @r;' `
            -Parameters @{ '@d' = $RetainDays; '@w' = [int] (-not $Apply); '@r' = [int] [bool] $DeleteRows }
        $t.Rows | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String | Write-Host
        if (-not $Apply) { Write-Host 'Nothing was cleared; add -Apply to clear it.' }
    }
}
}
finally { if ($runLock) { $runLock.Dispose() } }
